items.name: Dragonlord Placidusax
items.note: remembrance boss
items.mapNote: Optional Boss found near the tempest. Drops the Remembrance of the Dragonlord upon defeat. To reach this boss: • From the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace, take the lift back down and head back towards the entrance of the building. • From the entrance, head for cliffs directly west and look down at the edge for a series of ledges you can drop down onto. • Follow the floating platforms towards the tempest where you will find a large chunk of building debris with decorative frames containing skeletal remains. Look for the empty frame which will have a prompt for you to Lie Down. Doing so will teleport you to the boss' arena.

items.name: Axe of Godfrey
items.note: Obtained when unlocking the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux by handing it over to Enia at Roundtable Hold
info: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.
Arme de Godfrey, Seigneur d'Elden, brisée au cours d'une bataille qui survint pendant le Pèlerinage, alors qu'il menait les Sans-éclat.

items.name: Axe of Godrick
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted (from Godrick the Grafted) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage.
Grande hache maniée par Godrick le Greffé. Cette arme d'or est frappée d'un blason bestial représentant la force de Godfrey, premier Seigneur d'Elden et patriarche de la lignée dorée.

items.name: Bastard's Stars
items.note: Bastard's Stars can be obtained by giving Remembrance of the Naturalborn to Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel.
Fléau d'armes infligeant des dégâts magiques de par le pouvoir du souvenir d'Astel qu'il recèle.

items.name: Battle Axe
items.note: Starting Equipment for the Hero Class Can be purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes
info: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon
Lame lourde et épaisse fixée à un manche. Une arme polyvalente relativement ordinaire.

items.name: Blasphemous Blade
items.note: Trade Remembrance of the Blasphemous with Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade.
Épée sacrée de Rykard, seigneur du blasphème. Les restes des nombreux héros qu'il a dévorés s'agitent à la surface de la lame.

items.name: Carian Regal Scepter
items.note: Obtained when unlocking the Remembrance of The Full Moon Queen's power by handing it over to Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries.
Sceptre magique de Rennala, reine de la pleine lune. La pierre d'éclat dont il est serti est appelée "Bleu de Caria" et renforce les sorcelleries de la Pleine Lune.
effect: Renforce les sorcelleries de la Pleine Lune

items.name: Cipher Pata
items.note: Jump over the balcony rail in the Roundtable Hold; it is in the rooms to the left.
info: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage.
L'une des armes provenant des Deux Doigts. Sa lame est composée d'une suite de symboles informes, empêchant tout bouclier de parer ses coups. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Clinging Bone
items.note: Clinging Bone is dropped by Ensha of the Royal Remains ( Roundtable Hold )
info: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains.
Arme horrible conçue à partir d'un bras squelettique durci. Maniée par Ensha, porteur de la dépouille royale.

items.name: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow
items.note: Behind a Stonesword Key fog door in the Roundtable Hold, down the stairs in the eastern wing past Smithing Master Hewg (with 20 Black-Key Bolts).
info: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range.
Arbalète noire dotée d'une longue crosse. Idéale pour les tirs de précision grâce à sa très longue portée.

items.name: Dagger
items.note: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 400 Runes; also drops from dagger-wielding enemies.
items.mapNote: Looted from a Foot Soldier upon defeat.
info: A standard dagger with a straight blade.
Dague classique à la lame droite.

items.name: Dragon King's Cragblade
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Dragonlord (from Dragonlord Placidusax) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
items.fr: Lame rocheuse du Roi des dragons
info: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance.
Épée perçante en granite renfermant de la foudre primitive. Une partie du pouvoir du seigneur draconique, obtenue grâce à un souvenir.

items.name: Finger Seal
items.note: Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold, for 800 Runes.
info: A sacred seal bestowed by a Finger Maiden which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations.
Sceau sacré décerné par une Servante de l'Augure des Doigts. Sert de catalyseur pour les incantations sacrées.

items.name: Gazing Finger
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers (from Metyr) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: The head of Metyr, the finger-mother, wielded as a weapon without modification.
Tête de Metyr, la mère des Doigts, employée telle quelle en guise d'arme.

items.name: Giant's Red Braid
items.note: Obtained by trading Remembrance of the Fire Giant with Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant.
Fouet lourd tressé avec les cheveux ardents d'un Géant de feu.

items.name: Grafted Dragon
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted (from Godrick the Grafted) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was grafted to Godrick's left arm.
L'incarnation du pouvoir qui demeurait dans la tête de dragon greffée sur le bras gauche de Godrick.

items.name: Greatsword of Damnation
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame (from Midra) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. Used by the hornsent in the execution of a damnation like no other.
Espadon doré qui perça jadis le corps de Midra, maître du presbytère. Employé par les kérastiens pour infliger une damnation sans pareil.

items.name: Greatsword of Radahn (Light)
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord (from Promised Consort Radahn) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.
Espadons en acier noir maniés par Radahn durant sa jeunesse. Une paire d'armes ornées d'une crinière de lion.

items.name: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord (from Promised Consort Radahn) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.
Espadons en acier noir maniés par Radahn durant sa jeunesse. Une paire d'armes ornées d'une crinière de lion.

items.name: Hand of Malenia
items.note: Can be drawn by Enia out of the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess at the Roundtable Hold, obtained after killing Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
info: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot.
Lame conçue pour s'intégrer à la prothèse de bras de Malenia. La consécration qui l'imprègne lui permet de résister à la putréfaction.

items.name: Lion Greatbow
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge (from Starscourge Radahn) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif.
Arc géant manié par le général Radahn, aux ornements évoquant la crinière d'un lion.

items.name: Longbow
items.note: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,200 Runes; also Samurai starting gear and a Skeleton drop.
info: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage.
Arc long conçu pour décocher des flèches sur de longues distances. Comparé à un arc court, sa portée est supérieure et il inflige davantage de dégâts.

items.name: Longsword
items.note: Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.
info: A straight sword with a double-edged blade.
Épée droite à double tranchant.

items.name: Mace
items.note: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.
info: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions.
Massue en fer aux protubérances pointues.

items.name: Maliketh's Black Blade
items.note: Trade Remembrance of the Black Blade with Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory.
Lame d'ébène de Maliketh qui renfermait autrefois le pouvoir de la rune de Mort. Cette arme n'est plus que l'ombre d'elle-même.

items.name: Marika's Hammer
items.note: Trade Elden Remembrance with Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it.
Marteau en pierre créé dans le royaume des Numens, en dehors de l'Entre-terre. L'outil qu'employa la reine Marika pour briser le Cercle d'Elden et avec lequel Radagon tenta de le restaurer.

items.name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Blood Lord (from Mohg, Lord of Blood) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty.
Trident de Mohg, seigneur du sang. Une lance sacrée qui symbolisera un jour sa dynastie.

items.name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King (from Morgott) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.
Lame distordue changeant de teinte et appartenant à Morgott, roi Réprouvé.

items.name: Poleblade of the Bud
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud (from Romina) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Weapon of Romina, Saint of the Bud. A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot. Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade.
Arme de Romina, sainte du bourgeon. Cette vouge est coiffée d'une lame évoquant une jeune pousse. Les attaques accumulent de la putréfaction écarlate.

items.name: Putrescence Cleaver
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence (from the Putrescent Knight) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Weapon wielded by the Putrescent Knight. A great cleaver of hardened putrescence affixed to an arch fashioned from human bones.
Arme maniée par le chevalier putride. Ce grand fendoir est composé de putrescence coagulée assujettie à une arche constituée d'ossements humains.

items.name: Rapier
items.note: Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1000 Runes.
info: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.
Épée perçante à la lame élancée et pointue. Excellant dans les coups d'estoc, cette arme peut en prime être utilisée sans abaisser sa garde avec un bouclier.

items.name: Rellana's Twin Blades
items.note: Trade Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight with Enia at the Roundtable Hold, to receive this weapon.
info: Carian light greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. Weapon of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight.

Espadon léger de Caria incrusté de pierres d'éclat bleues. L'arme de Rellana, chevaleresse des Lunes jumelles. Deux armes en une. En la maniant à deux mains, son porteur tiendra une épée droite ornée d'une flamme dorée dans la main gauche.
skill: Posture du feu et de la lune

items.name: Rogier's Rapier
items.note: Given at +8 by Sorcerer Rogier at the balcony in Roundtable Hold after defeating Godrick the Grafted.
info: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier.
Épée perçante de qualité supérieure pourvue d'ornementations complexes. Arme emblématique de Rogier le Sorcier.

items.name: Sacred Relic Sword
items.note: Trade Elden Remembrance with Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.
Épée forgée à partir des restes d'un dieu qui aurait dû vivre éternellement.

items.name: Scimitar
items.note: Starting Equipment for the Warrior Class Can be purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 Runes
info: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales.
Épée courbée à tranchant unique. Permet d'exécuter des attaques de taille, mais se révèle peu efficace contre les armures et les créatures dotées d'épaisses écailles.

items.name: Shadow Sunflower Blossom
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower (from the Scadutree Avatar) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: The head of a monstrous shadow sunflower manifestation of the Scadutree. Then again, it might be just a flower, wielded as a weapon.
Tête d'une ombreflore, monstrueuse manifestation de l'Arbre-Occulte. À moins qu'il ne s'agisse d'une simple fleur, brandie en guise d'arme.

items.name: Short Spear
items.note: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks for 600 Runes; also Prophet starting gear and a Godrick Foot Soldier drop.
info: An exceedingly plain spear of modest weight.
Lance parfaitement banale et plutôt légère.

items.name: Spear of the Impaler
items.note: Trade Remembrance of the Impaler with Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Weapon of Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. Remade by the forging arts of the realm of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.
Arme de Messmer l'Empaleur. Grande lance sommée d'une lame distordue évoquant une flamme ondoyante.

items.name: Staff of the Great Beyond
items.note: lowing location: Trade Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers with Enia at the Roundtable Hold
info: Staff fashioned from the tail-fingers of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, and the microcosm raised aloft over the crux they form. Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations. The Mother received signs from the Greater Will from the beyond of the microcosm. Despite being broken and abandoned, she kept waiting for another message to come.
Bâton conçu à partir des doigts formant la queue de Metyr, la mère des Doigts, et du microcosme présent au-dessus de cet amas. Sert de catalyseur pour les sorcelleries et les incantations.

items.name: Starscourge Greatsword
items.note: Trade Remembrance of the Starscourge with Enia at Roundtable Hold.
info: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.
Espadons courbés en acier noir maniés par le général Radahn. Une paire d'armes ornées d'une crinière.

items.name: Sword Lance
items.note: Can be selected as one of the possible rewards when trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Enia at the Roundtable Hold. The other available reward is a sorcery, Blades of Stone.
info: Weapon once wielded by Commander Gaius. A combination of greatsword and lance.
Arme autrefois brandie par le commandant Gaïus. Rencontre improbable entre un espadon et une lance de cavalerie.

items.name: Winged Greathorn
items.note: Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor (from the Regal Ancestor Spirit) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Distinctive horn suffused with the power of ancestral spirits. This large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as a weapon of spirit worship.
Corne particulière débordant du pouvoir des esprits ancestraux. Ce spécimen en forme d'aile fait office d'arme d'adoration.

items.name: Bloodhound's Fang
items.note: Dropped by the Bloodhound Knight Darriwil, in Limgrave.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the boss of Forlorn Hound Evergaol, Bloodhound Knight Darriwil.
info: Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights.
Espadon courbé pourvu d'une lame légèrement ondulée, manié par les Chevaliers-limiers.

items.name: Bloodstained Dagger
items.note: Drops from Fierce Demi-Humans; one sits asleep near the bridge west of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Demihuman chief/Demihuman assassin sleeping before the wooden bridge leading to the minor eldtree in the weeping peninsula.
info: Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss.
Dague à la lame ensanglantée. Accumule du saignement chez l'ennemi.

items.name: Broadsword
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave (beneath the collapsed structure); also Confessor starting gear.
info: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks.
Épée droite dotée d'une large lame, idéale pour les attaques de taille.

items.name: Club
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in western Limgrave (southeast of Coastal Cave) for 600 Runes; also Wretch starting gear and a Demi-Human drop.
info: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill.
Morceau de bois épais et solide. Son maniement ne requiert aucune compétence particulière.

items.name: Dismounter
items.note: Drops from Kaiden Sellswords, e.g. on the path between Stormhill Shack and Warmaster's Shack, or at the camp northeast of Agheel Lake North.
info: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blade of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.
Espadon courbé porté par les mercenaires colossaux de Kaiden. Conjugue la lame acérée d'un cimeterre et le poids d'une hachette.

items.name: Dragon Communion Seal
items.note: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight in Fringefolk Hero's Grave (down the ramps from the Stranded Graveyard).
items.mapNote: Found in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave. Progress down the tunnel with the mechanized chariot until the path splits and you can go either up or down. Go up until you reach the end of the tunnel and inside the small room is an enemy that once killed will give you the weapon.
info: Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations.

Sceau informe constitué de sang de dragon, frappé de l'emblème de la communion draconique. Renforce les incantations de la communion draconique.  Les pouvoirs acquis au travers de la communion draconique sont trop primitifs pour pouvoir parler d'incantation. Grâce à ce sceau, la puissance des incantations se base sur l'ésotérisme.
effect: Renforce les incantations de la communion draconique

items.name: Erdtree Greatbow
items.note: In Fringefolk Hero's Grave, obtained by destroying the chariot (drop an urn onto it), with 10 Great Arrows.
items.mapNote: Dropped from the Chariot inside Fringefolk Hero's Grave
info: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow.
Arc géant aux ornements évoquant l'Arbre-Monde. Au temps jadis, quand bataille était synonyme de ferveur religieuse, cette arme fut créée pour décocher de grandes flèches dorées.

items.name: Falchion
items.note: Drops from falchion-wielding Demi-Humans; six of nine in the group northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace carry it.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Demi-Human enemies under the bridge.
info: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales.
Épée courbée à tranchant unique. Permet d'exécuter des attaques de taille, mais se révèle peu efficace contre les armures solides et les créatures dotées d'écailles épaisses.

items.name: Flail
items.note: In the black carriage furthest east at Gatefront Ruins.
items.mapNote: It can be found in a charriot, defended by a group of soldiers. near the Gatefront Ruins
info: Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by a chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss.
Arme composée d'une boule reliée à un manche par une chaîne. La boule de fer est hérissée de pics et provoque des saignements.

items.name: Forked Hatchet
items.note: Drops from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps; Stormfoot Catacombs is an easy early farm with two near the entrance grace.
info: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps.
Curieuse hachette maniée par les diablotins.

items.name: Glintstone Staff
items.note: Guaranteed drop from a Sorcerer Noble south of Waypoint Ruins, just west of the wolf graveyard.
info: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.
Bâton dont l'extrémité est constituée d'un morceau de pierre d'éclat. Sert de catalyseur pour les sorcelleries des pierres d'éclat.

items.name: Golden Halberd
items.note: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel boss in Limgrave (The First Step).
items.mapNote: Drops from Tree Sentinel
info: Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Deals holy damage.
Hallebarde pesante en or massif portée par les Sentinelles de l'Arbre, un ordre de chevaliers en armure lourde. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Golem's Halberd
items.note: Possible drop from a Golem wielding this weapon, the earliest respawning one being at Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Dropped by one of the Golems at the bridge.
info: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.
Grande hallebarde en pierre noire conçue par une civilisation désormais éteinte. Une arme maniée par les golems gardiens.

items.name: Great Epee
items.note: In a chest by a tent in a campsite among the Fallen Ruins east of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace, guarded by Kaiden Mercenaries and a Noble Sorcerer.
items.mapNote: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, and get down, you will find a group of enemies. The Great Epee is inside a chest. on the right side.
info: Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade. Commonly used in life or death duels.
Grande rapière à la lame fine et acérée, employée habituellement lors des duels à mort.

items.name: Great Knife
items.note: Drops from Small Demi-Humans; earliest just inside Lakeside Crystal Cave, with an efficient farm north of the Craftsman's Shack on Mt. Gelmir. Also Bandit starting gear.
info: Large knife with a broad, curved blade.
Grand couteau à la large lame courbée.

items.name: Greataxe
items.note: In a chest in a carriage hauled by two Trolls heading south on the road west of Waypoint Ruins.
items.mapNote: Found inside the treasure chest within the carriage being pulled by two large Trolls and defended by militia and aristocracy.
info: Greataxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains.
Grande hache ressemblant à un énorme morceau de fer forgé. Arme de prédilection des chefs des Terres stériles.

items.name: Halberd
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge in northern Limgrave; also Vagabond starting gear.
info: A long-handled polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.
Arme d'hast avec une longue hampe, à mi-chemin entre la hache et la lance.

items.name: Hand Axe
items.note: Sold for 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in eastern Limgrave (Mistwood, south of the Minor Erdtree).
info: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool.
Communément appelé "hachette", ce modèle de hache aux dimensions plus modestes est un outil du quotidien.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.note: Drops from crossbow-wielding Soldiers; three Godrick Soldiers just northwest of Gatefront Ruins are an early source.
info: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt.
Arbalète lourde aux branches de fer qui augmentent les dégâts infligés.

items.name: Knight's Greatsword
items.note: Drops from sword-wielding knights; two Godrick Knights are at the camp between the Warmaster's Shack and Saintsbridge. Also many later knights.
info: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title.
Espadon décerné aux chevaliers ayant servi avec ferveur les demi-dieux, qu'importe leur rang ou leur titre.

items.name: Lance
items.note: On a corpse on a squarish ruin northeast of the Warmaster's Shack.
items.mapNote: On top of the big square structure to the west of Deathtouched Catacombs. Jump off the nearby cliff to reach the top.
info: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce.
Considérée comme un genre de grande lance, cette arme conique effilée est conçue pour percer l'armure.

items.name: Large Club
items.note: On a corpse near a group of Demi-Humans south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol.
items.mapNote: On the lowest cliff south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, near a spiritspring
info: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill.
Épais et solide morceau de bois. Son maniement ne requiert aucune compétence particulière.

items.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
items.note: In the chest on a carriage just southeast of the Gatefront Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Found inside a Wagon Chest.
info: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.
Épée droite finement ouvragée et ornée, employée par les loyaux soldats de l'armée d'un seigneur.

items.name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
items.note: Drops from soldiers; farmable at Gatefront Ruins from Godrick Soldiers, or two Mausoleum Soldiers outside the Fourth Church of Marika.
info: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.
Épée droite finement ouvragée et ornée, employée par les loyaux soldats de l'armée d'un seigneur.

items.name: Nagakiba
items.note: Dropped by Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the end of his questline (Second Church of Marika), or after defeating him; via Frenzied Flame ending, where Shabriri stood near the Zamor Ruins.
items.mapNote: Can be obtained by completing Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline at the Second Church of Marika
info: Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers.
Katana pourvu d'une longue lame redoutable. Arme emblématique de Yura, chasseur de Doigts sanglants.

items.name: Noble's Estoc
items.note: Low drop chance from Wandering Nobles in Aristocrat garb; two are north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace.
info: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.
Estoc porté par les nobles errants. Conçu pour être simple d'utilisation.

items.name: Noble's Slender Sword
items.note: Dropped by Wandering Nobles around Limgrave. Can be farmed from the group of Wandering Nobles among the Troll -pulled Carriage's caravan to the west of Waypoint Ruins, north of Agheel Lake South Site of Grace.
info: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.
Lame étroite portée par les nobles errants. Conçue pour être simple d'utilisation.

items.name: Partisan
items.note: Drops from knight enemies, e.g. the Godrick Knight at Gatefront Ruins, or Leyndell Knights near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite.
items.mapNote: A Partisan Spear that can be dropped from a Godrick Knight in Fort Haight.
info: Spear with a wide tip.
Lance à la large pointe.

items.name: Reduvia
items.note: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus, who invades near Murkwater Cave.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus
info: Jagged dagger with a distinctive curved blade. Used by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.
Dague dentelée à lame courbée. Utilisée par les nobles serviteurs du seigneur du sang.

items.name: Shamshir
items.note: On a corpse on the largest pillar in the water inside Highroad Cave, guarded by two Giant Bats.
items.mapNote: Found inside the Highroad Cave, on a platform after the waterfall section, being feasted on by Giant Bats.
info: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession.
Épée courbée à la lame fine et longue. Légère malgré sa grande taille, elle permet d'enchaîner les attaques de taille avec vivacité.

items.name: Short Sword
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge for 600 Runes; also Astrologer starting gear.
info: A short straight sword with a short blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.
Épée droite courte à double tranchant. En plus d'infliger des dégâts normaux, cette arme parfaitement équilibrée permet de porter de puissantes attaques perçantes.

items.name: Shortbow
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in western Limgrave (southeast of Coastal Cave) for 600 Runes; also Bandit starting gear.
info: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback.
Petit arc conçu pour décocher des flèches sur de longues distances. Outre sa capacité à enchaîner plusieurs tirs rapides, il est également fort maniable à dos de monture.

items.name: Torch
items.note: Bought from Merchant Kale at the Church of Elleh for 200 Runes.
info: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies.
L'extrémité de cette torche a été enveloppée de chiffons imbibés d'huile. Elle peut illuminer des endroits sombres ou servir d'arme.

items.name: Twinblade
items.note: In a chest in the southeastern basement room of the Dragon-Burnt Ruins, reached by jumping over a crumbled wall with Torrent.
items.mapNote: Can be found once you take the stairs down Dragon-Burnt Ruins.
info: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield and demands high dexterity.
Épée pourvue de lames de part et d'autre de la poignée. Cette arme difficile à manier requiert une grande dextérité.

items.name: Uchigatana
items.note: The Uchigatana can be found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs in Stormhill, Limgrave. Pull the lever to unlock a door in one of the earlier halls.
items.mapNote: Found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs. It is in a body, hanging from the upper platform. You need to use the lever in order to reach that room. Beware of the Skeleton Archers.
info: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade. A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds.
Katana dont la lame courbe ne possède qu'un seul tranchant. Arme portée par les samouraïs des Terres des roseaux.

items.name: Warpick
items.note: Drops from soldiers of every faction that wield it (2%); found from Limgrave onward.
items.mapNote: Looted from one of the many Undead Soldiers.
info: Battle hammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence.
Marteau de guerre pourvu d'un solide bec protubérant. Une pioche conçue pour le combat, en somme.

items.name: Golem Greatbow
items.note: Drops from Guardian Golems that wield it across the Lands Between (e.g. the bridge to the Divine Tower of Limgrave) - no single fixed location.
items.mapNote: Chance to drop by Golem Archer.
info: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem.
Arc géant en pierre noire, vestige d'une civilisation disparue. Arme des golems gardiens.

items.name: Bastard Sword
items.note: Sold for 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
info: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.
Grande épée à la lame droite. Cet espadon se porte généralement à deux mains, mais ceux qui en ont la force peuvent le manier d'une seule.

items.name: Claymore
items.note: In a building in Castle Morne's courtyard; from the Castle Morne Lift take the elevator up, then climb the pile of bodies in the courtyard.
items.mapNote: From the main courtyard entrance, hug the right wall past the burning corpses and harpies to reach the entrance to the building in the north. The sword is found in a chest to the left as you enter.
info: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.
Grande épée avec une longue lame droite. Cette épée lourde se porte généralement à deux mains, mais ceux qui en ont la force peuvent la manier d'une seule.

items.name: Demi-Human Queen's Staff
items.note: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen in Weeping Peninsula - Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen elite enemy in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
info: Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence.
Bâton de pierre d'éclat aux allures de sceptre. Présent jadis offert en gage de paix aux semi-humains. Ne nécessite guère d'intelligence.

items.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by the Leonine Misbegotten at the end of Castle Morne.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Leonine Misbegotten upon defeat.
info: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret. One of the legendary armaments.
Épée chargée de l'histoire du Château de Vent-Hurlant. L'arme d'un être vengeur, imprégnée d'un torrent de colère et de regrets. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Grossmesser
items.note: Drops from Skeletons; one is just past the grace in Tombsward Catacombs behind a Stonesword Key fog door. Also many later catacombs.
info: Curved sword boasting a large blade. This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.
Épée courbée pourvue d'une grande lame. Conçue pour allier poids et un tranchant particulièrement acéré.

items.name: Hand Ballista
items.note: In a chest atop the Forest Lookout Tower in the Weeping Peninsula, southwest of the Bridge of Sacrifice.
items.mapNote: At the top of the Forest Lookout Tower, west of the Bridge of Sacrifice.
info: An unconventional ballistic device modelled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts.
Instrument balistique fort peu conventionnel, inspiré d'une arme employée pour assiéger les places fortes. Tire uniquement des grands carreaux.

items.name: Iron Cleaver
items.note: Drops from cleaver-wielding Misbegotten; ~8 gather at the pyre reached from the Castle Morne Lift grace.
info: Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.
Fendoir en fer de bonne taille, couramment utilisé par les chimères opprimées.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.note: Sold for 1,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
info: Ranged weapon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing.
Arme à distance composée d'un arc monté sur une crosse. Inflige des dégâts respectables et se manie aisément, mais doit être rechargée après chaque tir.

items.name: Longhaft Axe
items.note: Drops from larger Scaly Misbegotten; found at Castle Morne and Morne Tunnel, plus later areas.
items.mapNote: Rare drop from enemies wielding it at Castle Mourne in Weeping Peninsula. There is an easy to kill one from Beside the Rampant Gaol site of grace, cross the bridge and will be on the left sleeping.
info: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten.
Grande hache de fer munie d'un long manche, maniée par les chimères opprimées.

items.name: Morning Star
items.note: Weeping Peninsula: Found in a chest inside a broken Carriage just a bit south of the bridge from Limgrave. Video of the location of the item
items.mapNote: Found in a chest inside a broken wagon along the road.
info: Battle hammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star is covered in spikes which cause blood loss.
Marteau de guerre composé d'une boule fixée à un manche. Bien qu'il s'agisse d'une arme contondante, elle est hérissée de piques provoquant des saignements.

items.name: Nightrider Flail
items.note: Dropped by Night's Cavalry at Weeping Peninsula.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that spawns at night near Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
info: A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.
Fléau d'armes doté de deux boules supplémentaires. Porté par les cavaliers crépusculaires qui chevauchent de funèbres montures.

items.name: Red Branch Shortbow
items.note: Drops from Pages and Noble Pages, e.g. at Tombsward Ruins (also Raya Lucaria, Caria Manor, Redmane Castle and later areas).
items.mapNote: Drops from an Assassin on the study, past the Trumpeteer
info: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages.
Arc court en bois rouge poli. Portée par les pages, cette arme est l'œuvre d'un maître artisan.

items.name: Rusted Anchor
items.note: Dropped by the Scaly Misbegotten area boss in Morne Tunnel.
items.mapNote: Greataxe dropped by Scaly Misbegotten located in Morne Tunnel.
info: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks.
Ancre rouillée employée en guise d'arme. Grâce à ses quatre oreilles épaisses et pointues, elle permet d'exécuter des attaques perçantes.

items.name: Sacrificial Axe
items.note: Weeping Peninsula (Nighttime only): Dropped by Deathbird that spawns north from Castle Morne.
items.mapNote: Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)
info: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity.
Hachette utilisée lors d'un antique rite sacrificiel. Représente un rapace funeste sous la forme d'une divinité malfaisante.

items.name: Soldier's Crossbow
items.note: Drops from crossbow-wielding foot soldiers; an early farm is the cliff overlooking the Saintsbridge grace, but found from Weeping Peninsula onward.
info: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy.
Arbalète rudimentaire très simple d'utilisation, mais dont la puissance et la précision laissent à désirer.

items.name: Spiked Spear
items.note: Drops from spear-wielding Marionette Soldier enemies (no single fixed location).
items.mapNote: Chance for it to drop from a Marionette Soldier enemy just outside of Witchbane Ruins.
info: Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss.
Arme composée d'un cylindre à pointes fixé sur un long manche. Inflige des dégâts contondants en plus des saignements causés par les pics.

items.name: Steel-Wire Torch
items.note: At the end of a narrow path guarded by two Misbegotten on the north side of Castle Morne's top level (from the Castle Morne Lift).
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path at the top level of the castle. Guarded by two harpies.
info: Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies.
Torche entourée de barbelés. Elle peut illuminer des endroits sombres ou servir d'arme.

items.name: Whip
items.note: In the second prison cell area of Castle Morne, reached by dropping onto beams; the room is full of rats and a Misbegotten.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse inside the building known as the Rampart Gaol. This building is first accessed by walking atop the western wall of the castle. Look to the left for a building with a blue roof. Jump onto this roof and then jump down to the cliffs below. Follow the cliffs southeast until you return to a section of the castle with a big square opening. Descend into the opening by landing on the wooden beams. There is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [2] on one of the beams and there are several Rats and a Harpy at the ground level. The corpse with the whip is sitting against a wall.
info: A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain.
Fouet en cuir. Il s'agit davantage d'un instrument de torture que d'une arme de combat.

items.name: Winged Scythe
items.note: Underground in the Tombsward Ruins on the Weeping Peninsula.
items.mapNote: Located In the center of Tombsward Ruins, there is a set of stairs leading underground into a dark hall with a door to a small room at the end. The scythe is inside a chest in the small room.
info: Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage.
Faux sacrée dont la lame évoque une paire d'ailes blanches. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Zweihander
items.note: the Isolated Merchant for 3,500 Runes. He can be found in his shack at the very west of the Weeping Peninsula.
info: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so.
Sans doute la plus grande épée qu'il soit humainement possible de manier. Cette arme se manie à deux mains, d'où son nom, mais elle n'en requiert pas moins une force colossale.

items.name: Arbalest
items.note: On a corpse behind an Exile Soldier manning an explosive ballista, reached by jumping a gap on the rampart past the Rampart Tower.
items.mapNote: Using a Stonesword Key to access, additionally obtaining the Godskin prayerbook and Godslayer Seal: From the Rampart Tower bonfire, take the shortcut lift down to where the Grafted miniboss is fought inside the storeroom (or reach this point manually). Exit into the courtyard with the flamethrowers and barricades. Take an immediate left and hug the wall until you enter a cellar containing rats. You will hit a fog wall that requires one Stonesword Key to open. Continue past this fog wall until you reach an outdoors area again. Pull an immediate right and hug the wall until you reach a ladder. Continue past this point and almost all the way across the bridge, then jump to the rocky outcropping to your right (it's a tight jump). Continue and jump back into a walled-in area with a ballista. The Arbalest is on a corpse in that area.
info: Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt-firing devices.
Grande arbalète réalisée à partir de matériaux composites. L'une des armes tirant des carreaux les plus massives.

items.name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
items.note: Drops from sword-and-shield Banished Knights, e.g. in Stormveil Castle southwest of the Rampart Tower; also outside Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid.
info: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
Espadon finement ouvragé aux ornements antiques.

items.name: Banished Knight's Halberd
items.note: Dropped by a halberd-wielding Banished Knight near the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle; +8 version dropped by Edgar.
info: A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Hallebarde finement ouvragée aux ornements antiques. Remise aux chevaliers contraints de quitter leur foyer pour des raisons obscures, peut-être en guise de blâme ou simplement par la force des choses.

items.name: Brick Hammer
items.note: On a corpse in Stormveil Castle near the room where you get trapped with a Banished Knight, reached by jumping across a gap.
items.mapNote: Can be found on the 3rd floor. It is in a corpse dangling from a window.You have to access from the 4th floor, using the wooden platforms outside.
info: Weapon made from an ordinary stone brick. Wielded by a laborer who lead a rebellion, and later become a champion himself.
Arme réalisée à partir d'une banale brique de pierre. Brandie par un ouvrier qui devint un champion lors d'une rébellion.

items.name: Caestus
items.note: Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc (at Stormveil Castle) for 800 Runes.
info: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets.
Arme composée de cuir robuste incrusté de rivets de fer et conçue pour frapper à la force du poing.

items.name: Crescent Moon Axe
items.note: Users can get it in Stormveil Castle as drop from axe-wielding Exile Soldiers.
info: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia.
Grande hache pourvue d'une lame courbée et d'un long manche. Elle aurait été baptisée "Hache lunaire" par un individu tourmenté par la mélancolie.

items.name: Godslayer's Seal
items.note: The Godslayer's Seal weapon can be found at Stormveil Castle
items.mapNote: Found in a room barred by an Imp Statue seal, requiring a to access. From the Rampart Tower, take the lift that leads to the Grafted Scion's hall. Exit into the courtyard where plenty of Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae. Take a hard left from this exit to find a small stairway leading into a cellar. There are several Rats in this cellar and the Imp Statue barrier behind them. The Seal is found in one of the chests behind the barrier.
info: Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian.
Sceau sacré des apôtres sanctechair, incrusté d'obsidienne.

items.name: Highland Axe
items.note: Stormveil Castle.
items.mapNote: Found in the same hall as the Grafted Scion miniboss, under a large painting.
info: Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands.
Hache à tranchant unique maniée par les guerriers des montagnes.

items.name: Hookclaws
items.note: Located at Stormveil Castle.
items.mapNote: Claw weapon. Found on a corpse in the corner of a small corridor on the first level of the wine cellar, filled with crates and patrolled by a single Castle Guard.
info: Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect.
Arme pourvue de lames aiguisées parallèles, à porter au niveau du poing. Elle est surtout appréciée par ceux qui aiment frapper dans l'ombre. Ses lacérations causent d'abondants saignements.

items.name: Misericorde
items.note: Stormveil Castle. Can be looted off a corpse that can be found in the large armory room, next to the fortress of the Grafted Scion.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.
info: Dagger favored by military physicians in white. The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent.
Dague appréciée des médecins militaires vêtus de blanc. Grâce à sa lame effilée, robuste et acérée, elle permet de porter des coups critiques dévastateurs.

items.name: Omen Cleaver
items.note: Just outside the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, beside a Stray; also drops from Omens in catacombs.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Omen enemy in the northwest section of the courtyard. It is advised to take out all of the lesser enemies nearby before taking on the ogre.
info: Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.
Épée courbée lourde d'une taille colossale, jadis décernée aux Réprouvés pour leur servir d'arme de guerre et conçue pour exploiter tout le potentiel de la force brute.

items.name: Parrying Dagger
items.note: Drops from various dagger enemies; obtainable early at Stormveil Castle (also sold/looted across the Lands Between).
info: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.
Couteau à la garde courbée, conçu pour parer et retourner les attaques des ennemis contre eux.

items.name: Pike
items.note: On a corpse in the open courtyard with flamethrower enemies in Stormveil Castle.
items.mapNote: Can be looted off a corpse that's lying on the heavily guarded courtyard. The nearest checkpoint is the Liftside Chamber site of grace
info: A longspear featuring an especially lengthy handle.
Lance à la hampe particulièrement longue.

items.name: Spear
items.note: Drops from Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle; +7 version from Patches' questline.
info: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft.
Arme composée d'une lame fixée au bout d'un long manche.

items.name: Torchpole
items.note: Dropped by Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle.
info: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead.
Torche montée sur une longue perche. Illumine les endroits sombres, mais ne peut être brandie plus haut.

items.name: Wakizashi
items.note: Drops from various enemies; obtainable from soldiers around Stormveil Castle / Limgrave (also a Foot Soldier drop).
items.mapNote: Found within Gaol Cave
info: Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss. These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordsman known only as Okina.
Épée courte portant des marques de trempe sur sa lame. Arme de prédilection des guerriers des Terres des roseaux. Accumule du saignement chez l'ennemi.

items.name: Warhawk's Talon
items.note: Drops from Warhawks; four are on the walls outside the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle (also Castle Sol).
info: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use.
Les épées-serres sont attachées sur les pattes des faucons de guerre de Voilorage. Celle-ci a cependant été réadaptée pour les humains.

items.name: Weathered Straight Sword
items.note: Drops from Commoner enemies in Stormveil Castle, e.g. the three by the fireplace in the Grafted Scion room.
info: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people.
Épée droite à la lame assez courte, mais plutôt large. Facile d'utilisation, elle était très répandue parmi la populace.

items.name: Astrologer's Staff
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace for 800 Runes; also starting gear for the Astrologer class.
info: Staff of the astrologers. A glintstone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.
Bâton des astrologues. Son extrémité est constituée d'un morceau de pierre d'éclat, lui permettant de servir de catalyseur pour les sorcelleries.

items.name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
items.note: In a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo, reached via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.mapNote: Looted on the ground inside a room that is full of crystals. It's on the east side, the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo within Raya Lucaria Academy.
info: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.
Bâton d'Azur le Sorcier originel. Seuls ceux qui ont touché à l'impénétrable sagesse des pierres peuvent le porter.

items.name: Carian Glintblade Staff
items.note: Highway Lookout Tower in eastern Liurnia: Found on the top floor.
items.mapNote: Found on the top floor of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia.
info: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.
Bâton serti d'une pierre d'éclat bleue, représentant l'une des deux catégories de bâtons de Caria.

items.name: Carian Glintstone Staff
items.note: Located on a throne in Carian Study Hall right before the second lift in Liurnia of the Lakes.
items.mapNote: Found at the Carian Study Hall.
info: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.
Bâton serti d'une pierre d'éclat bleue, représentant l'une des deux catégories de bâtons de Caria.
effect: Renforce les sorcelleries de lame de Caria

items.name: Carian Knight's Sword
items.note: Held by a carriage in northwest Liurnia, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and the Four Belfries.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest at the back of a large stagecoach being pulled by 2 Trolls.
info: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty.
Épée droite incrustée d'une pierre d'éclat bleue. Lame des chevaliers ayant juré allégeance à la couronne de Caria.

items.name: Composite Bow
items.note: Sold for 3,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant down an incline north of Bellum Church in northern Liurnia.
info: Bow composited from a mix of materials.
Arc réalisé à partir de divers matériaux.

items.name: Crystal Knife
items.note: In a chest in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel; after the first elevator, cross the wooden beam to the second room on the right guarded by two Marionette Soldiers.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest inside the storage room in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel protected by Marionettes.
info: A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners.
Couteau obtenu en affûtant un cristal dur. Arme typique des mineurs de pierre d'éclat.

items.name: Crystal Sword
items.note: Found after the bridge from the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in Liurnia.
items.mapNote: Can be found at Village of the Albinaurics. Past the well and the wooden bridge, on a body near the edge.
info: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.
Épée de cristal pur. Un ouvrage hors de portée pour un humain. Imprégnée d'une puissance magique, ses attaques sont renforcées par l'attribut d'intelligence de son porteur.

items.name: Curved Great Club
items.note: This weapon can be looted from the larger of the Second-Generation Albinaurics found across Liurnia of the Lakes (the gray frog like creatures)
info: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon.
Grand gourdin courbé en bois dur et en forme de croissant de lune.

items.name: Estoc
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Liurnia near the Lake Shore for 3,000 Runes (also from Patches; Prisoner starting gear).
info: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.
Grande épée perçante pourvue d'une longue lame dentelée et solide, également capable d'asséner des coups de taille.

items.name: Executioner's Greataxe
items.note: Drops from greataxe-wielding Giant Skeletons, e.g. west of Church of Irith / near the tower southeast of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia.
info: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber.
Fendoir massif fixé sur un long manche. Il aurait servi à achever les survivants des armées vaincues, telle une hache débitant des arbres.

items.name: Forked Greatsword
items.note: Drops from wolf-headed greatsword Imps; one is just down the stairs after the Road's End Catacombs grace. Also in many later catacombs.
info: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps.
Espadon difforme manié par les diablotins.

items.name: Frozen Needle
items.note: In a chest in Kingsrealm Ruins after defeating the Royal Revenant boss.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest inside a small room in an underground area of the ruins. The Royal Revenant needs to be defeated to gain access to this room.
info: A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Iji, the Carian Royal Blacksmith.
Épée de glace fine et perçante. Forgée par Iji, forgeron de la famille royale de Caria.

items.name: Great Mace
items.note: In a chest among the trebuchets before the Grand Lift of Dectus in Liurnia.
items.mapNote: Can be found inside a chest, in the bandit camp.
info: Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin.
Énorme masse en fer aux protubérances pointues.

items.name: Icerind Hatchet
items.note: In a chest in a small broken tower in southern Temple Quarter, southwest of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
items.mapNote: Axe found inside a chest in the Temple Quarter. The chest is located in what remains of the tower of a ruined building, by some poison flowers.
info: A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north.
Hachette à la lame nimbée de givre. Un des présents offerts à Solcastel, loin au nord.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.note: Received from Blackguard Big Boggart when he is killed (he is first met at the Boilprawn Shack in Liurnia).
items.mapNote: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart.
info: Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice.
Arme en fer de forme sphérique, emblématique du malfrat Gros Boggart.

items.name: Ivory Sickle
items.note: Found near the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in Liurnia.
items.mapNote: Can be found at the Village of the Albinaurics.It is up a small hill from the Site of Grace, past a perfumer enemy, behind a coffin. Nearby, Albus hides as a pot.
info: Sickle fashioned from ivory. Weapon carried by aged Albinaurics.
Faucille taillée dans de l'ivoire. Arme portée par les Albinauriques âgés.

items.name: Lucerne
items.note: Near a broken wagon north of the Liurnia Highway North grace.
items.mapNote: East of Highland Lookout Tower in East Liurnia of the Lakes, found in the battlefield between phantoms and knights near where the armored giant spawns. Break some carts to reveal the treasure.
info: This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor.
Arme d'hast pourvue d'une pointe solide et acérée semblable à un bec, conçue pour percer les armures.

items.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
items.note: Drops from Magma Wyrm Makar in Ruin-Strewn Precipice in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.
items.mapNote: Curved Greatsword dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar
info: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales.
Espadon courbé recouvert d'écailles solides, manié par les Dragons du magma. Sa forme rappelle celle d'une mâchoire de dragon.

items.name: Nightrider Glaive
items.note: Dropped by a Night's Cavalry north of the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace (only appears at night), with the Ash of War: Giant Hunt.
items.mapNote: Halberd dropped by miniboss Night's Cavalry. Only appears at night.
info: A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.
Vouge d'un noir de jais dont la lame est aussi lourde qu'une massue. Arme des cavaliers crépusculaires qui chevauchent de funèbres montures.

items.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
items.note: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation (beat it at game start, or revisit via the Four Belfries in west Liurnia).
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.
info: Slender straight sword patterned after an antique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand.
Épée droite fine représentant une antique ornementation. Les épéistes expérimentés préfèrent tenir un exemplaire de cette arme dans chaque main.

items.name: Ripple Blade
items.note: Sold by Pidia, Carian Servant, for 3,500 Runes on the hidden floor behind Caria Manor (after Royal Knight Loretta).
info: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species.
Arme unique maniée par les jeunes Albinauriques, cette épée imite les ondulations qu'on dit à l'origine de leur espèce.

items.name: Rosus' Axe
items.note: Inside Black Knife Catacombs in northeast Liurnia (requires one Stonesword Key).
items.mapNote: An Axe found in the room sealed by the Imp Statue in the Black Knife Catacombs.
info: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe.
Cette hache rituelle est ornée d'une représentation de Rosus le berger funèbre, qui montre le chemin des catacombes dispersées dans l'Entre-terre.

items.name: Royal Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by Blaidd at Ranni's Rise after completing Ranni's questline.
items.mapNote: Obtainable at the end of Ranni's questline; Blaidd will spawn in front of Ranni's Rise tower. Best him in combat for a final time to obtain this weapon along with his armor set.
info: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf.
Espadon décoré dans le style royal de Caria. Arme favorite de Blaidd le Semi-loup.

items.name: Scythe
items.note: On a body on the upper floor of Cliffbottom Catacombs in southeast Liurnia, guarded by four stone Imps.
items.mapNote: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs: toward the end of the dungeon, find a staircase to go up into a room with some Imps and a trap.
info: Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.
Grande faux dotée d'une longue et fine lame. Conçue pour la moisson, cette arme accumule rapidement du saignement et permet de trouver une faille dans la garde de l'ennemi.

items.name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
items.note: On a balcony in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice in Liurnia.
items.mapNote: Can be found at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, after the first singing bat go up two ladders then another one on the left and walk across to where the Land Octopus are
info: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir.
Épée courbée représentant une antique divinité ophique. Instrument d'une religion oubliée que l'on pratiquait sur le Mont Gelmir.

items.name: Staff of the Guilty
items.note: Liurnia of the Lakes: The Thorn Sorcerer that drops Briars of Sin to the northwest of the Artist's Shack site of grace has a low chance to drop this staff.
info: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glintstone. Similar to hex magic.
Bâton hérétique conçu à partir d'un arbuste calciné et flétri, qui transforme le sang des victimes qu'il transperce en pierres d'éclat. Un procédé comparable à de la magie noire.
effect: Boosts thorn sorcery ; Causes slight blood loss buildup
Renforce les sorcelleries d'épines ; Accumule du saignement

items.name: Sword of Night and Flame
items.note: In a chest in a locked tower room at Caria Manor, jumped into from the walkways above where the Raya Lucaria puppets appear.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest inside a locked room behind the gardens. This is accessible by using the walkways above. You can get onto the walkways from the Chapel building in the west.
info: Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments.
Cette précieuse épée du Manoir de Caria est chargée d'histoire. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Treespear
items.note: a Carriage at the edge of the collapsed bridge. From Liurnia Highway South Site of Grace, follow the road southeast.
items.mapNote: Found on the Caravan left at the edge of the collapsed bridge.
info: Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals holy damage.
Lance dorée aux ornements d'apparence végétale. Maniée par les chevaliers qui gardent le palais de Leyndell, la capitale royale. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Troll Knight's Sword
items.note: Guaranteed drop from the Troll Knight in Caria Manor just before Royal Knight Loretta; also farmable at Converted Fringe Tower and the Four Belfries.
items.mapNote: Dropped by a Troll Knight guarding the staircase leading up to the boss of Caria Manor.
info: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.
Espadon incrusté d'une pierre d'éclat bleue. Arme des trolls au service de la famille royale de Caria.

items.name: Urumi
items.note: On a corpse up on the rooftops of Caria Manor in Liurnia.
items.mapNote: Found on a body on the south-east ramparts, reached by jumping from the higher ramparts leading to the elevator and the Manor Upper Level site of grace.
info: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfolk warriors.
Arme composée de lames de métal extrêmement fines et flexibles, utilisée tel un fouet par les guerriers nyxiens.

items.name: Vyke's War Spear
items.note: Dropped by Festering Fingerprint Vyke, who invades at the Church of Inhibition in Liurnia.
items.mapNote: Can be dropped from Festering Fingerprint Vyke
info: War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold.
Lance de guerre marquée d'une empreinte digitale calcinée et boursouflée, portée par Vyke, chevalier du Bastion de la Table ronde.

items.name: Warped Axe
items.note: Drops from axe-wielding Omens; two are in Cliffbottom Catacombs and two near the Abandoned Coffin grace by the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.
info: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance.
Hache à double tranchant surdimensionnée, dont une partie semble avoir étrangement fondu.

items.name: Watchdog's Staff
items.note: Located in Road's End Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes From the lever, travel down both flights of stairs
items.mapNote: Located in Road's End Catacombs, behind an illusory wall near the stairs at the beginning of the dungeon.
info: Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs.
Grand bâton de pierre incrusté de pierres d'éclat porté par les veilleurs de l'Arbre-Monde qui protègent les catacombes.

items.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
items.note: At the end of Ranni's questline, where she sat beneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes, after giving her the Dark Moon Ring.
items.mapNote: Found below the Cathedral of Manus Celes after progressing Ranni's questline.
info: A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments.
Espadon lunaire offert par les reines de Caria à leur époux en vertu d'une tradition ancestrale. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Academy Glintstone Staff
items.note: Looted from Thops' body. You must give him the Academy Glintstone Key first.
items.mapNote: Can be found on Sorcerer Thops' body near the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace after giving him the Academy Glintstone Key.
info: Staff of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, embedded with a turquoise glintstone.
Bâton de l'Académie de Raya Lucaria, serti d'une pierre d'éclat turquoise.

items.name: Crystal Staff
items.note: Academy Crystal Cave. The Staff is behind an illusory wall in the room right before the boss gate.
items.mapNote: Crystal Staff can be found in Academy Crystal Cave. It's in a room guarded by a sorcerer behind a fog wall, located right before the boss gate. The path to the chest containing the staff is through an illusory rock wall on the left side of the tunnel, just before the stone archway.
info: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.
Bâton conçu à partir de cristal pur, un ouvrage hors de portée pour un humain. Renforce les sorcelleries cristaliennes.

items.name: Full Moon Crossbow
items.note: In a chest atop a tower on the rooftops of Raya Lucaria.
items.mapNote: From the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, head out into the courtyard and to the left to reach the rooftops. Continue along the rooftops until the tower past the Glintstone Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers. Across from the tower on another rooftop, an item will be visible. Drop down to the rooftop below and jump on top of the spike near the right edge. From the spike, turn left and jump onto the gargoyle (architectural, not an enemy) protruding from a corner of the building. Another jump will bring you to the rooftop with the item, a Smithing Stone [4]. Alternatively, you can reach this item by jumping from the tower onto a roof opposite the Full Moon Crossbow's chest in the tower. From that roof, a long jump will be required to reach the rooftops with the patrolling Marionette Soldier with spears. Sprinting before the jump is required, as a normal jump will not cover the distance. Note that there is a delay before sprinting starts (likely to determine whether the player is trying to roll or sprint). Continue along the rooftops to the left, past the four Marionette Soldiers and jump onto a platform connected to a tower. Inside, two Marionette Soldiers will ambush you from either side. Climb up the ladder to find a chest with the Full Moon Crossbow.
info: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy-infused bolts.

Arbalète enchantée unique en son genre, aux détails d'une exquise précision. Conçue pour célébrer l'union matrimoniale, et la réconciliation, des maisons de l'Arbre-Monde et de la pleine lune, de Leyndell et de Raya Lucaria. Les deux disques tournoient lorsque l'arme se recharge. Révèle son véritable potentiel lorsque vous décochez des projectiles imprégnés de sacré.

items.name: Glintstone Kris
items.note: Received for siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren at the end of her questline (Raya Lucaria).
info: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

Lame rituelle jadis offerte en geste de paix à Leyndell par l'Académie de Raya Lucaria. Bien que cette arme soit incrustée de précieuses pierres d'éclat et ornée de symboles dynastiques de l'Arbre-Monde, sa lame sinueuse évoque un rituel antique.

items.name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
items.note: Drops from Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers; one is just outside the Schoolhouse Classroom grace, before the Red Wolf of Radagon.
items.fr: Épée de pierre d'éclat de Lazuli
info: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage.
Épée à la garde sertie d'une pierre d'éclat. Maniée par les étudiants du cursus de Lazuli, qui aspirent à maîtriser les sorcelleries de Caria. Inflige des dégâts magiques.

items.name: Antspur Rapier
items.note: Guaranteed drop from Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan, found just west of the Shaded Castle with a Guardian Golem.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan upon defeat.
info: Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot.
Éperon d'une fourmi géante ayant été converti en rapière. La lame suinte de putréfaction écarlate.

items.name: Bandit's Curved Sword
items.note: Bandit's Curved Sword can be dropped by the Skeletal Bandits in Limgrave & Altus Plateau One of these Skeletal Bandits can be farmed easily just next to the Church of Pilgrimage Site of Grace
info: Curved sword with a light, crescent-shaped blade. Used by the bandits who ran rampant in the wake of the Shattering.
Épée courbée dont la lame légère dessine un croissant. Arme de prédilection des bandits qui pullulèrent suite à l'Éclatement.

items.name: Black Knife
items.note: This is a drop from defeating the Black Knife Assassin at the entrance of Sainted Hero's Grave, in Altus Plateau. This boss is directly west of the Rampartside Path site.
items.mapNote: Dagger dropped from the Black Knife Assassin
info: Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives.
Dague appartenant jadis à l'un des assassins qui tuèrent Godwyn le Doré lors de la Nuit des Couteaux noirs.

items.name: Bloody Helice
items.note: In the Writheblood Ruins in Altus Plateau, found in a chest after the boss.
items.mapNote: Can be found inside a chest, in the same room of the boss in Writheblood Ruins
info: Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.
Sombre épée perçante à la lame ondulée, maniée par les nobles serviteurs du seigneur du sang.

items.name: Celebrant's Cleaver
items.note: Drops from cleaver-wielding Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, in northern Altus Plateau.
info: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.
Fendoir orné de tissus bariolés. Outil cérémoniel utilisé au cours des danses qui avaient lieu lors des festivités de Dominula, village aux moulins.

items.name: Celebrant's Rib-Rake
items.note: Drops from Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, northern Altus Plateau.
info: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.
Râteau orné de tissus bariolés. Outil cérémoniel utilisé au cours des danses qui avaient lieu lors des festivités de Dominula, village aux moulins.

items.name: Celebrant's Sickle
items.note: Drops from the blue Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village; two are just east of the Windmill Village Site of Grace.
info: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.

Faucille ornée de fleurs et de tissus bariolés. Outil cérémoniel utilisé au cours des danses qui avaient lieu lors des festivités de Dominula. Ses attaques sont capables de trouver une faille dans la garde des ennemis.

items.name: Celebrant's Skull
items.note: On a corpse at the end of a narrow ledge northeast of and below the Windmill Village Site of Grace in Dominula.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse at the cliff directly north from Windmill village site of grace
info: Large bludgeon decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.
Grand gourdin orné de fleurs et de tissus bariolés. Outil cérémoniel utilisé au cours des danses qui avaient lieu lors des festivités de Dominula, village aux moulins.

items.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
items.note: Dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger, at the Second Church of Marika.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger
info: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger.
Naginata double forgée dans les Terres des roseaux. Arme de prédilection d'Eleonora le Doigt sanglant pourpre.

items.name: Family Heads
items.note: Dropped by Necromancer Garris, behind an illusory wall inside Sage's Cave, Altus Plateau.
items.mapNote: Dropped from boss of Sage's Cave, Necromancer Garris.
info: Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage.
Trois têtes contondantes en cuivre reliées à un manche par des chaînes. Arme emblématique du nécromancien Garris, le sage hérétique.

items.name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
items.note: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle just north of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace in Altus Plateau.
items.mapNote: Dropped byGargoyle. From the Outer Wall Phantom Tree.Site of Grace go northeast the Slope/long Stairs up until it spawns.
info: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Grande hache en bronze maniée par les gargouilles vaillantes.

items.name: Giant-Crusher
items.note: In a carriage south of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace in Altus Plateau.
items.mapNote: Can be found in a chest inside an unmarked military camp directly to the south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace.
info: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.

Marteau conçu à partir d'un rocher et utilisé pendant la Guerre contre les Géants. Une des armes les plus lourdes de toute l'Entre-terre. Lorsque la menace des Géants fut éloignée et que les Hommes commencèrent à s'entretuer, cette arme tomba dans l'oubli. L'humain est devenu faible, comparé à ses ancêtres.

items.name: Godskin Peeler
items.note: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle at the end of Dominula, Windmill Village.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village.
info: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh.

Lame double unique à l'apparence fort singulière, maniée par les apôtres sanctechair. Une extrémité est pourvue d'une faucille pour porter des attaques de taille, tandis que l'autre est dotée d'une lame torsadée conçue pour pénétrer les chairs.

items.name: Great Club
items.note: Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll inside Old Altus Tunnel (requires two Stonesword Keys).
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss inside the Old Altus Tunnel upon defeat.
info: An enormous club of hard wood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.
Énorme gourdin en bois durci. Frapper des ennemis avec cette arme ne requiert aucune dextérité. Seule la force brute importe.

items.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
items.note: Dropped by the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom duo in Perfumer's Grotto; also from an Omenkiller in Volcano Manor.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the boss duo of Perfumer's Grotto: Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom.
info: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omenkillers.
