La lame de cet immense et sordide fendoir, arme de prédilection des tueurs de Réprouvés, est constituée de cornes de Réprouvés amputées.

items.name: Great Stars
items.note: In a wandering caravan near the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace in Altus Plateau (also drops from Magnus the Beast Claw).
items.mapNote: On a guarded wagon in Altus Plateau, traveling on the road SouthWest of the Road of Iniquity Side Path site of grace.
info: Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss.
Énorme masse pourvue de trois boules hérissées de pics en son extrémité. Bien qu'il s'agisse principalement d'une arme contondante, les pointes provoquent des saignements.

items.name: Harp Bow
items.note: On a cliff east of Sainted Hero's Grave (after examining the Champion's Song painting inside the Shaded Castle wall).
items.mapNote: Acquired by solving the Champion's Song Painting, found in The Shaded Castle
info: Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows.
Réalisé à partir d'une harpe de ménestrel, cet arc émet des accords lorsqu'une flèche est décochée.

items.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
items.note: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar at the top of the Shaded Castle.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle.
info: Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments.
Épée historique de la maison Tourbier, la famille de bourreaux qui dirigeait le Bastiombre. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Ordovis's Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo at the bottom of Auriza Hero's Grave.
items.mapNote: Obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis and his regular Crucible Knight companion in their Duo Boss Fight inside the Auriza Hero's Grave.
info: Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights.
Espadon d'Ordovis, l'un des deux chevaliers du Creuset les plus célèbres.

items.name: Raptor Talons
items.note: In a chest behind an illusory wall beyond a four-skeleton room inside Sage's Cave, Altus Plateau.
items.mapNote: Located at Sage's Cave, in one of the chests, behind several secret walls
info: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades. Wielded by the assassins of ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds.
Griffes composées de deux lames fines et acérées, maniées par les assassins de Corbemont. Cette arme permet d'imiter les attaques des rapaces funestes.

items.name: Troll's Golden Sword
items.note: In a chest in a carriage in a Leyndell Soldier camp between the Erdtree-Gazing Hill and Altus Highway Junction graces.
items.mapNote: In a Chest on a Black Carriage, which can be found east of Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace.
info: Sword given to the lesser giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago.
Épée décernée aux trolls qui combattirent pour l'Arbre-Monde lors de l'antique Guerre contre les Géants.

items.name: Twinned Knight Swords
items.note: On a corpse just northwest of the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.
items.mapNote: In a burning corpse pile in front of East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.
info: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.
Élégante lame double finement ouvragée, très prisée des chevaliers.

items.name: Albinauric Staff
items.note: Volcano Manor near the Guest Hall site of grace. Exit the room containing the grace, turn left, then turn left again, heading down the hall with the Caged Albinauric hanging from the ceiling.
items.mapNote: Found in Volcano Manor near the Guest Hall grace. Head left from the bonfire, then left again, taking the stairs to the next floor. Head outside and take the ladder to your left onto the roof. Go to the back of the roof and jump off the right side to be taken to a room with an Omenkiller, the Albinauric Staff, and Albinauric Mask.
info: Short staff with a blue glintstone embedded. Wielded by the Albinaurics of old.
Court bâton serti d'une pierre d'éclat bleue. Porté par les Albinauriques d'antan.

items.name: Bloodhound Claws
items.note: Bloodhound Claws can be dropped by a Lesser Bloodhound Knight in the basement of the Volcano Manor.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Bloodhound Knight in the secret passage of Volcano Manor.
info: Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights.
Grandes griffes incurvées utilisées par les Chevaliers-limiers.

items.name: Butchering Knife
items.note: Drops from Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, who invades outside the Corpse-Stench Shack on Mt. Gelmir.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater.
info: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.

Énorme couteau conçu pour dépecer les corps humains. Arme emblématique de l'ogresse Anastasia, réputée pour avoir dévoré d'innombrables Sans-éclat en se faisant passer pour une Servante de l'Augure des Doigts.

items.name: Erdtree Seal
items.note: a corpse in a cell near the Omenkiller enemy in the town below the Prison Town Church Site of Grace in Volcano Manor.
info: A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between.
Sceau sacré informe frappé de l'emblème de l'Arbre-Monde, jadis le siège religieux de l'Entre-terre.

items.name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
items.note: Dropped by the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast in Mt. Gelmir.
items.mapNote: Colossal Weapon Dropped by Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast
info: Part of a Fallingstar Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon.
Partie durcie, sombre et lustrée de la mâchoire d'une bête stellaire transformée en arme.

items.name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
items.note: Drops from the egg-headed Man-Serpent near the throne in Volcano Manor, just before Rykard's teleporter.
info: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.
Bâton à l'extrémité fourchue et garnie de pierres d'éclat rouges. Renforce les sorcelleries de lave.

items.name: Ghiza's Wheel
items.note: Reward for killing phantom Inquisitor Ghiza in Volcano Manor.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Inquisitor Ghiza in Volcano Manor.
info: Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss.
Grande roue en fer bordée de lames lacérantes. Un instrument de torture utilisé par l'inquisiteur Ghiza. Les rotations de cette arme occasionnent d'importants saignements.

items.name: Godskin Stitcher
items.note: Dropped by the Godskin Noble boss in Volcano Manor.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Godskin Noble
info: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles.
Somptueuse épée perçante pourvue d'une lame céladon que manient les nobles sanctechair.

items.name: Inquisitor's Girandole
items.note: Dropped by the Abductor Virgin duo boss in Volcano Manor.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Abductor Virgins.
info: Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir.
Instrument de torture employé sur les nobles dans les recoins secrets du Manoir du volcan qui trône sur le Mont Gelmir.

items.name: Jar Cannon
items.note: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot inside Volcano Cave.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot when defeated.
info: Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload.
Jarre en forme de canon utilisant des explosifs pour tirer des grands carreaux. Inflige d'importants dégâts, mais prend du temps à recharger.

items.name: Magma Blade
items.note: Possible drop from Man-Serpent enemies wielding the orange glowing Magma Blade at Volcano Manor. Two of the Serpents can be easily accessed by going up the wooden elevator outside of the building to the North of the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace: one enemy...
info: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made.
Épée courbée dont la lame fut forgée dans la lave du Mont Gelmir. Une arme qu'aucun humain n'aurait pu créer, conçue spécifiquement pour les reptiliens.

items.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
items.note: Reward from Patches in Volcano Manor after defeating Great Horned Tragoth (reload and speak to him again).
items.mapNote: Rewarded by Patches after completing his Volcano Manor quest.
info: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir.
Chandelier à trois branches servant d'objet de rituel, dont les flammes solides proviennent du magma du Mont Gelmir.

items.name: Mantis Blade
items.note: Dropped by a Cemetery Shade in a nook in Gelmir Hero's Grave, just before the final lava stretch.
items.mapNote: Dropped by a Cemetary Shade inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave. This enemy can be found by heading down the first Chariot hall until you reach a point where there is a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop into the left pit onto some wooden beams and then drop into the room below. The shade is in an alcove in the eastern wall.
info: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers.
Épée courbée pourvue d'une lame à chaque extrémité. Maniée par les ombres des cimetières, gardiens des tombes recouverts d'insectes.

items.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
items.note: Dropped by a Fire Prelate in Fort Laiedd, west of Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir (one per playthrough).
items.mapNote: Drops from the Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd
info: Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship.
Marteau colossal rappelant la forme d'un feu crépitant. Arme des prélats qui dirigent les moines-gardiens du feu. Son poids considérable représente le devoir qui incombe à son propriétaire.

items.name: Pulley Bow
items.note: On a corpse up a tower near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
items.mapNote: Pulley Bow can be found on a sitting corpse (at the top of a siege tower near Mt. Gelmir campsite. The tower is located to the northeast of Gelmir Hero's Grave.
info: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.

Arc long garni de poulies et de ressorts. Décrit comme l'œuvre d'un certain génie qui avait acquis les connaissances mathématiques et mécaniques complexes nécessaires à sa création à travers le fondamentalisme de l'Ordre d'or.

items.name: Pulley Crossbow
items.note: On a corpse on the wooden platforms just outside the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Can be found on a body at the Craftsman's Shack
info: Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism. One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.

Arbalète garnie de poulies et de ressorts. Décrite comme l'œuvre d'un certain génie qui avait acquis les connaissances mathématiques et mécaniques complexes nécessaires à sa création à travers le fondamentalisme de l'Ordre d'or. Une simple pression suffit pour lâcher une volée de carreaux ; prenez toutefois garde de ne pas épuiser votre réserve.

items.name: Ringed Finger
items.note: In a chest inside Gelmir Hero's Grave on Mt. Gelmir.
info: Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper.
Massue faite à partir d'un énorme doigt engoncé dans de lourds anneaux. Il aurait été arraché à un ancêtre du Doigt-larve.

items.name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
items.note: Mt. Gelmir, on a corpse near a Grafted Scion across a stone pillar-bridge north west of the First Mt.
items.mapNote: Found in Mt. Gelmir, on a corpse near a Grafted Scion across a stone pillar-bridge northwest of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace. The corpse closest to the ladder has the blade.
info: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles.
Épée courbée unique pourvue de dents semblables à celles d'un requin. Une arme utilisée par les pilleurs de cadavres qui opèrent sur les sites d'anciennes batailles.

items.name: Serpent-Hunter
items.note: Picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard in Volcano Manor.
items.mapNote: Held by a corpse on the left as you enter the boss chamber of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. This weapon has a special interaction when fighting Rykard in both his first phase as the God-Devouring Serpent and second phase as Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
info: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.
Arme qui tient autant de l'espadon que de la lance. Censée avoir jadis servi à traquer un grand serpent immortel, elle génère une longue lame de lumière face aux créatures semblables.

items.name: Serpentbone Blade
items.note: Given as a reward for completing the second letter quest in Volcano Manor from Tanith.
items.mapNote: Rewarded by Tanith after completing the second letter quest.
info: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone.
Katana sinistre s'inspirant d'un os de serpent.

items.name: Thorned Whip
items.note: Drops from Fire Prelate enemies that wield it (Mt. Gelmir, Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave).
info: Hefty whip covered in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin.
Fouet imposant hérissé d'épines pourpres. Arme des prélats qui gouvernent les moines-gardiens du feu. Redoutable instrument de persuasion religieuse, dont les aiguillons symbolisent le péché.

items.name: Troll's Hammer
items.note: On a corpse inside Old Altus Tunnel (requires two Stonesword Keys).
items.mapNote: Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.
info: Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock.
Outil de minage dont se servent les trolls fouisseurs pour briser la roche.

items.name: Dragon Greatclaw
items.note: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel, fought at Capital Outskirts.
items.mapNote: Colossal Weapon that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel
info: Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree.
Arme conçue, selon la légende, à partir de la griffe d'un illustre dragon ancien et maniée par les Sentinelles de l'Arbre grotesques qui servent l'Arbre-Monde.

items.name: Golden Order Seal
items.note: On a corpse next to the Minor Erdtree Church Site of Grace in the Capital Outskirts.
items.mapNote: Found right at the base of the Minor Erdtree surrounded by the remains of the Church.
info: A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Order Fundamentalist incantations.
Sceau sacré informe représentant l'acceptation cérémonielle de l'ordre. Renforce les incantations des fondamentalistes de l'Ordre d'or.
effect: Renforce les incantations de l'Ordre d'or

items.name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by the Onyx Lord boss at the end of the Sealed Tunnel in Capital Outskirts.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Onyx Lord when defeated.
info: Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.
Espadon conçu à partir d'un minerai météorique teinté d'or. Sa lame renferme une magie de manipulation gravitationnelle.

items.name: Sentry's Torch
items.note: Sold by the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack for 7,000 Runes.
info: Torch given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.
Torche transmise aux protecteurs de l'Arbre-Monde. Ses flammes proviennent d'une incantation spéciale qui permet au porteur de voir les assassins dissimulés dans l'ombre.

items.name: Sword of Milos
items.note: Dropped by Dung Eater (NPC Invader) in the Capital Outskirts moat. He can be found in this location after releasing his corporeal body from his cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and then reading his message at the Roundtable Hold.
info: Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. Metes out wounds like a lopsided saw-blade, and restores some FP upon defeating an enemy.
Espadon sinistre taillé dans l'échine d'un Géant. Inflige des blessures similaires à celles d'une scie asymétrique et restaure des PC à chaque ennemi vaincu.

items.name: Battle Hammer
items.note: Drops from hammer-wielding Grave Warden Duelists in Leyndell (they stop spawning after Maliketh).
items.mapNote: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Murkwater Catacombs.
info: Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
Grand marteau de guerre en fer conçu pour les combats d'arène. Arme maniée par les gladiateurs qui furent jadis bannis du colisée.

items.name: Black Bow
items.note: a corpse on a rooftop, accessible by jumping across the houses to your right when you descend the lift that leads to the lower level of Leyndell, Royal Capital. From the Avenue Balcony site of grace, head down the stairs into the area with the archer, immed...
items.mapNote: Bow that can be found on the roof on the right that overlooks the area. Need to jump from roof to roof in order to reach it.
info: Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master.
Arc long sculpté dans du bois noir, imitant l'apparence d'une lame. L'un des arcs les plus difficiles à manier qui soient.

items.name: Cane Sword
items.note: On a corpse next to the stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell.
items.mapNote: West Capital Ramparts Site of Grace, Go south out of the room with the site of grace and down the flight of stairs to the floor underneath, make a complete U-turn in the room with the stairs to find a corpse with the sword
info: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.
Épée d'un chevalier âgé ayant accompli sa dernière quête il y a fort longtemps et s'en servant depuis comme d'une canne de marche. La pointe est relativement usée.

items.name: Coded Sword
items.note: upstairs throne room of Fortified Manor, Leyndell Royal Capital. From Fortified Manor, 1st Floor site of grace, head outside the building, turn right, climb the stable roofs to the right and re-enter the second floor of the Fortified Manor.
items.mapNote: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Look for an abandoned horse stable, then climb onto its roof and enter the building. Keep going until you find a broken round table. Look for the double door. Inside that room you will find the coded sword.
info: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.

Épée secrète octroyée par les Deux Doigts aux Sans-éclat de la Table ronde. Sa lame est composée d'une suite de symboles informes et inflige des dégâts sacrés imparables. En des temps immémoriaux, à l'époque où les Deux Doigts étaient encore vigoureux et capables de prouesses oratoires, les champions se rassemblaient au Bastion de la Table ronde.

items.name: Duelist Greataxe
items.note: Drops from Grave Warden Duelist enemies near the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell.
info: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
Grande hache conçue pour les combats d'arène. Arme maniée par les gladiateurs qui se battaient jadis dans le colisée.

items.name: Erdsteel Dagger
items.note: Found NW of the Avenue Balcony site of Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drop down a pit with a Broken Statue and it will be on a corpse.
items.mapNote: Drop down a pit with a Broken Statue and it will be on a corpse.
info: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.
Dague en acier-monde gravée de motifs végétaux. Portée par la royauté de l'Arbre-Monde pour pouvoir se défendre en temps de paix.

items.name: Frenzied Flame Seal
items.note: Obtained in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds by completing Hyetta's questline - accept the Three Fingers' blessing, then touch her.
items.mapNote: Reward from completing Hyetta's Questline. Hyetta can be finally found at Frenzied Flame Proscription, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Upon accepting the Three Fingers flame, return to Hyetta and talk to her once more. Exhaust her dialogue, and she will give you the Frenzied Flame Seal, completing her questline.
info: Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame.
Sceau sacré décerné par la Servante des Trois Doigts. Renforce les incantations de la Flamme exaltée.
effect: Boosts Frenzied Flame incantations ; Causes slight madness buildup
Renforce les incantations de la Flamme exaltée ; Accumule de la démence

items.name: Gargoyle's Halberd
items.note: Dropped by the Gargoyle near the West Capital Rampart grace in Leyndell.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Lesser Black Blade Kindred.
info: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Hallebarde en bronze maniée par une gargouille vaillante.

items.name: Golden Epitaph
items.note: At the entrance of Auriza Hero's Grave; requires a Stonesword Key and is guarded by a Basilisk.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse in a room locked behind an Imp Statue Seal just past the Site of Grace. Use a Stonesword Key to unlock the seal and beware the Basilisk guarding the treasure.
info: A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die.
Épée conçue pour commémorer le trépas de Godwyn le Doré, premier demi-dieu à mourir.

items.name: Gravel Stone Seal
items.note: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, walk north to the next room with the single guard inside. Jump over the balcony railing to get to the area next to the Fortified Manor with the dragon foot.
items.mapNote: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, walk north to the next room with the single guard inside. Jump over the balcony railing to get to the area next to the Fortified Manor with the dragon foot. The knight with the spear supported by an archer drops this seal.
info: Sacred seal made from Gravel Stone thought to be an ancient dragon scale. Enhances Dragon Cult incantations of the Royal Capital.
Sceau sacré de granite qui serait en réalité une écaille de dragon ancien. Renforce les incantations du culte draconique de la capitale royale.

items.name: Greatbow
items.note: Chance to drop from a Leyndell Knight wielding it in Altus Plateau, near the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower.
info: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary.
Grand arc aux dimensions dépassant l'entendement. Tout bonnement inutilisable à moins de posséder une force surhumaine, la puissance de ses tirs est en revanche dévastatrice.

items.name: Hammer
items.note: On the upper floor of the Fortified Manor, next to the Sanctified Whetblade.
items.mapNote: Found inside the Fortified manor, beside the Sanctified Whetblade
info: Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.
Marteau constitué d'une grosse pierre fixée à un manche en métal. À l'origine, il s'agissait d'un outil de forgeron. On raconte que l'art de la forge proviendrait des Géants.

items.name: Iron Greatsword
items.note: Possible drop from the two Misbegotten Warriors in Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the ash-covered path leading toward the Forbidden Lands. Closest site of grace is the Avenue Balcony in Leyndell.
info: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept.
Espadon pourvu d'une lame en acier particulièrement épais. Une arme grossière pour qui le concept d'aiguisage n'existe pas.

items.name: Stormhawk Axe
items.note: In the court outside the Fortified Manor where the Abductor Virgins roam in Leyndell; also in Castle Sol and from Nepheli Loux.
items.mapNote: Looted from a dead body in the courtyard with Iron Maidens near Fortified Manor, First Floor at Leyndell, Royal Capital
info: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, with its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth.

Hache de guerre inspirée d'un faucon dont les ailes forment la lame. Arme emblématique des guerriers qui s'efforcent de ne faire qu'un avec la tempête, bien qu'ils soient fort éloignés de leur terre natale.

items.name: Bolt of Gransax
items.note: Cannot be acquired in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. You must get it before defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade at Crumbling Farum Azula.
items.mapNote: Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital after beating Godfrey, First Elden Lord; walk outside of the west door, take the elevator down, and walk up the spear.
info: Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments.
Lance sculptée à partir de l'arme que maniait Gransax. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Erdtree Bow
items.note: This item can still be obtained in Leyndell, Ashen Capital if the player has progressed to that point.
items.mapNote: Climb the root found at the east, head up to the west, once outside again, jump on the roof to the left and enter inside the window. Loot the chest.
info: Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow.
Arc long aux ornements évoquant l'Arbre-Monde. Au temps jadis, quand bataille était synonyme de ferveur religieuse, cette arme fut créée pour décocher des flèches dorées.

items.name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
items.note: Dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing, when defeated in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
info: Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All-Knowing's hand grasps for it.
Sceptre ayant la forme d'une main saisissant une perle. Arme emblématique de sire Gideon Ofnir l'Omniscient.

items.name: Star Fist
items.note: The left side of the colosseum near the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace, in the last opening on a body, in Leyndell, Royal Capital. (Can also be obtained, in the same place, in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.)
items.mapNote: In the left side of a castle situated atop the mountain near the West Capital Rampart grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
info: Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss.
Arme en fer sphérique recouverte de pics capable de provoquer des saignements.

items.name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
items.note: Drops from Cleanrot Knights; the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid is littered with them. Also in the Shaded Castle, Elphael and Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.
info: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
Épée perçante des chevaliers de la Noble putréfaction qui combattirent aux côtés de Malenia, épée de Miquella.

items.name: Commander's Standard
items.note: Dropped by Commander O'Neil in the Swamp of Aeonia, Caelid.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.
info: A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd.
Hallebarde vétuste enroulée dans un étendard de guerre rouge élimé.

items.name: Cross-Naginata
items.note: Looted from a body in Gael Tunnel.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse inside the Gael Tunnel, in the cavern filled with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus.
info: Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana.
Arme composée de trois lames dentelées fixées à une longue hampe. La longue lame centrale ressemble fortement à un katana.

items.name: Crystal Spear
items.note: In a chest behind an illusory wall in Sellia Hideaway, Caelid.
info: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

Lance conçue à partir de cristal pur, un ouvrage hors de portée pour un humain et imprégné d'une puissante magie. Ses attaques sont affectées par l'intelligence de son porteur. Les cristaliens, des êtres insondables, n'ont qu'un seul but : protéger leurs cristaux quoiqu'il leur en coûte. Selon une théorie, ils attendraient le retour de leur créateur, lequel leur sculptera de nouveaux compagnons.

items.name: Death's Poker
items.note: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Caelid, southeast of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace, at night.
items.mapNote: Dropped by miniboss Death Rite Bird that appears only at night.
info: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds.
Canne barbelée utilisée par les rapaces funestes.

items.name: Digger's Staff
items.note: Drops from Glintstone Miners in crystal mines; Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid is the earliest spot (also Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, Altus Tunnel).
items.mapNote: Drops from Diggers inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
info: Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.
Bâton d'un sorcier-minier qui extrayait des pierres d'éclat dans les galeries cristallines. Le bâton en lui-même est un outil de minage, dont l'extrémité est sertie d'une pierre d'éclat.

items.name: Flamberge
items.note: Atop a tower right of the stairs to the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight courtyard in Redmane Castle, guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head (after the festival).
items.mapNote: Greatsword found on a corpse on the roof of the building in the southeast of Redmane Castle.
info: Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shreds enemy flesh, inducing blood loss.
Espadon dont la forme ondulée rappelle le vacillement d'une flamme. Arrache la chair des ennemis, occasionnant des saignements.

items.name: Glaive
items.note: Drops from Graveyard Skeletons, such as the one near the Sellia Backstreets grace in Caelid.
info: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war.
Arme composée d'une lame acérée fixée au bout d'un long manche. En réalité, il s'agit d'une faucille convertie en instrument de guerre.

items.name: Godslayer's Greatsword
items.note: Divine Tower of Caelid: Found in a chest behind the Godskin Apostle boss arena after defeating him.
items.mapNote: Greatsword found in a chest in a room behind the Godskin Apostle's arena at the Divine Tower of Caelid after defeating him.
info: Sacred sword of the Gloam-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh.
Lame sacrée de la reine aux yeux crépusculaires qui contrôlait les apôtres sanctechair avant sa défaite contre Maliketh.

items.name: Greatsword
items.note: Caelid. North-west to the Caelem Ruins Site of Grace, inside the chest in the back of the Carriage guarded by Giant Dogs.
items.mapNote: Looted from the chest in the enemy caravan traveling the Caelid Highway.
info: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight.
Grand espadon en fer grossier. Abat ses ennemis de tout son poids.

items.name: Katar
items.note: In a chest in Fort Gael, Caelid.
items.mapNote: Looted from a treasure chest in Fort Gael. You can find the chest inside a dark room on the elevated platform above the Lion Guardian.
info: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.
Dague étrangère pourvue d'une poignée unique en son genre. Elle ne fait qu'un avec son porteur, telle l'extension de sa propre main.

items.name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
items.note: In a chest after the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk fight in Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest in the building north of the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses' chamber after defeating them.
info: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.
Bâton de Lusat le Sorcier originel. Seuls ceux qui ont touché à l'impénétrable sagesse des pierres peuvent le porter.

items.name: Meteoric Ore Blade
items.note: n: Caelid Waypoint Ruins: Found inside a chest in a small room at the back of an underground hall filled with sarcophagi and Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pests) enemies
items.mapNote: Found inside a chest in a small room at the back of an underground hall filled with sarcophagi and Prawn Miners enemies. The entrance is found in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins.
info: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage.
Katana forgé à partir de minerai météorique, conçu pour éliminer les êtres nés des étoiles filantes. Inflige des dégâts magiques.

items.name: Meteorite Staff
items.note: Aeonia Swamp in Caelid: In the southwestern building of the Street of Sages Ruins. The staff is on a corpse hanging from a ledge in a small room with poison flowers and a rune.
items.mapNote: Glintstone Staff with S scaling but no upgrades. Found on a corpse hanging from a window in Street of Sages Ruins in the swamp of Caelid.
info: Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well.
Bâton serti d'une pierre d'éclat violet foncé, qui serait en réalité un fragment de météorite. Amplifie les bonus d'attribut des sorcelleries, en plus de renforcer les sorts gravitationnels.

items.name: Moonveil
items.note: Obtained upon defeating the Magma Wyrm located in Gael Tunnel - Caelid.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Magma Wyrm inside Gael Tunnel.
info: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian swordsmith.
Katana forgé à partir de pierres d'éclat. Chef-d'œuvre d'un forgeron de Sellia.

items.name: Nox Flowing Sword
items.note: Dropped by the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk duo in Sellia, Town of Sorcery (light the three braziers to remove the seal).
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses upon defeat.
info: A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle.
Arme sombre que manient les épéistes de la Ville éternelle. La lame de ce shotel est aussi fine qu'une aiguille.

items.name: Regalia of Eochaid
items.note: On a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, east of the Third Church of Marika (reached via Gaol Cave or tricky jumps).
items.mapNote: Accessed by dropping down to this area after progressing through Gaol Cave
info: Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone.
Épée précieuse d'Eochaid, une faction mineure désormais éteinte. Sa teinte cuivrée n'est en rien de la rouille, mais elle permet à son porteur de la plier à sa volonté.

items.name: Ruins Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight duo at Redmane Castle plaza (when the festival is inactive).
items.mapNote: Acquired by defeating the Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo bosses at Redmane Castle
info: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments.
Fragment de ruine tombée du ciel transformé en arme. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Serpent Bow
items.note: Inside the Abandoned Cave in Caelid.
items.mapNote: Found by a pool of rot within Abandoned Cave
info: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows.

Arc difforme représentant un duo de serpents venimeux et qui puise dans une magie païenne pour octroyer un effet de poison aux flèches. Révèle son véritable potentiel lorsque vous décochez des projectiles imprégnés de poison.

items.name: Spiked Caestus
items.note: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in Caelid for 4,000 Runes.
info: A caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes.
Ceste dont les rivets ont été remplacés par des pointes lacérantes qui accumulent des saignements.

items.name: Staff of Loss
items.note: On a corpse on a balcony in northwestern Sellia, Town of Sorcery, eastern Caelid.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse leaning over a building's balcony. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.
info: Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism.
Bâton privé de sa pierre d'éclat. Porté par les sorciers qui estiment que seul l'ascétisme permet d'atteindre la véritable connaissance.

items.name: Sword of St. Trina
items.note: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, below the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Found inside a chest in the underground cellar of the Forsaken Ruins.
info: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes.
Épée d'argent portée par les clercs de sainte Trina. Endort les ennemis.

items.name: Venomous Fang
items.note: the Abandoned Cave in Caelid. The cave is above the swamp area, and you have to walk along a branch to get to it.
items.mapNote: Climb on the Iron Maidens near the end of the Abandoned Cave to acquire them.
info: One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
Une des armes conçues pour les combats d'arène. Arme maniée par les gladiateurs qui se battaient jadis dans le colisée.

items.name: Beast-Repellent Torch
items.note: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in the Isolated Merchant's Shack in north-west Dragonbarrow for 1,200 Runes.
info: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts.
Torche brûlant à l'aide d'une huile imprégnée d'un encens spécial. Elle émet une fumée qui apaise les bêtes sauvages.

items.name: Beastclaw Greathammer
items.note: Awarded by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum for feeding him 7 Deathroot.
items.mapNote: Given by Gurranq after turning in their 7th Deathroot.
info: Great hammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws.
Marteau de guerre à l'extrémité contondante façonnée pour évoquer cinq griffes de bête.

items.name: Clawmark Seal
items.note: Given by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum after feeding him 1 Deathroot.
info: Sacred seal granted by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.
Sceau sacré octroyé par Gurranq le Clerc bestial. L'une des rares reliques permettant aux incantations d'exploiter la force comme caractéristique principale.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
items.note: Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the Bestial Sanctum, along with the Gargoyle's Blackblade.
items.mapNote: Halberd dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum.
info: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Hallebarde en bronze maniée par une gargouille championne, enduite d'adipocire noire. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
items.note: Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred outside the Bestial Sanctum, along with the Gargoyle's Black Halberd.
items.mapNote: Greatsword dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum.
info: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Espadon en bronze manié par les gargouilles vaillantes. Enduit d'adipocire noire.  Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Blade of Calling
items.note: In a hidden room reachable only during the elevator ride down to the Forbidden Lands Site of Grace; jump from the southwestern part of the elevator to a doorway near the bottom.
items.mapNote: From the Forbidden Lands site of grace, turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Blade of Calling is on the table in the room at the end of this hall
info: Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent.
Dague offerte à quelqu'un qui entreprit jadis un long périple pour remplir son devoir. Recèle encore des échos du pouvoir de son ancienne propriétaire, une jeune femme vouée à servir de combustible.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
items.note: Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Blades.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold.
info: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Grande hache en bronze maniée par une gargouille championne, enduite d'adipocire noire. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
items.note: Guaranteed drop from the Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Axe.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold.
info: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Lame double en bronze enduite d'adipocire noire, maniée par les gargouilles vaillantes. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
items.note: In Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, behind the second imp statue in the dungeon.
items.mapNote: Found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave on a corpse at the end of the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the room with the flamethrower pillar.
info: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.

Candélabre employé par les fidèles de Birac, saint parmi les prélats des moines-gardiens du feu. Inquiet devant la désinvolture des moines maniant la Flamme des Géants, Birac se trancha lui-même la tête en guise d'avertissement, dans le but qu'elle serve de chandelier. Sa foi inébranlable brûle toujours dans le réceptacle crânien.

items.name: Death Ritual Spear
items.note: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird fought in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird boss upon defeat.
info: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds.
Lance rituelle employée par des prêtres d'antan que les rapaces funestes ont acceptés dans leurs rangs.

items.name: Eclipse Shotel
items.note: In front of the altar inside the Church of the Eclipse in Castle Sol.
items.mapNote: Found at the altar of the Church in the southeast section of the castle.
info: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments.
Épée chargée d'histoire, véritable trésor de Solcastel orné d'un soleil éclipsé dénué de couleur. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Giant's Seal
items.note: Near a Fire Prelate inside Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (reached via the hidden elevator compartment, then a ladder to the left).
info: Sacred seal depicting the one-eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair.
Sceau sacré représentant le dieu cyclope des Géants de feu, paré de tresses rousses.
effect: Renforce les incantations de la Flamme des Géants

items.name: Helphen's Steeple
items.note: Dropped by a Tibia Mariner overlooking Castle Sol, near the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Tibia Mariner boss found up on a ridge south of Castle Sol.
info: Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world.
Espadon conçu sur le modèle du sombre clocher d'Helfen, érigé pour guider les morts dans le monde des esprits.

items.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
items.note: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood, after invading him for Tanith's final Volcano Manor contract.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood upon defeat.
info: Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down through the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow. High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastating blood loss. "The tale of House Hoslow is told in blood."

Fouet en métal constitué de lames-maillons semblables à des pétales de fleur. Véritable chef-d'œuvre transmis de génération en génération au sein de l'illustre maison Hoslow. Si une grande dextérité est nécessaire pour manier cette arme, elle cause des saignements absolument dévastateurs. "L'histoire de la maison Hoslow est écrite dans le sang."

items.name: Monk's Flameblade
items.note: Drops from a sword-wielding Flame Monk in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (behind an illusory wall and flame trap).
info: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants.
Épée courbée ornée d'un motif de flammes vacillantes. Maniée par les moines-gardiens du feu originaires des Cimes des Géants.

items.name: Monk's Flamemace
items.note: Drops from Fire Monk enemies, notably in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.
info: Battle hammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.
Marteau de guerre dont la forme rappelle celle de flammes vacillantes. Arme emblématique des moines-gardiens du feu, originaires des Cimes des Géants.

items.name: Rivers of Blood
items.note: Okina invades near the Church of Repose, found in the Eastern region of Mountaintops of the Giants.
items.mapNote: Katana dropped by NPC invader Bloody Finger Okina. Spawns near the Church of Repose in the later areas of the game.
info: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.
Arme d'Okina, épéiste des Terres des roseaux. Une lame maudite ayant ôté de nombreuses vies.

items.name: Veteran's Prosthesis
items.note: Dropped by Commander Niall in Castle Sol.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Commander Niall upon defeat.
info: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.
Prothèse de jambe pourvue d'une lame et imprégnée du pouvoir de la foudre. S'accroche au niveau du poing.

items.name: Watchdog's Greatsword
items.note: Drops from non-boss Erdtree Burial Watchdogs in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave and Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (also Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs).
info: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs.
Espadon en pierre manié par les veilleurs de l'Arbre-Monde.

items.name: Zamor Curved Sword
items.note: Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor at the end of Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave upon defeat.
info: Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants.
Arme maniée par les chevaliers de Zamor, héros de la Guerre contre les Géants.

items.name: Albinauric Bow
items.note: Dropped by Albinauric Wolfback Archers around the Consecrated Snowfield. At least four Albinauric Archers can be found south-southwest of the Ordina, Liturgical Town sight of grace.
info: Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers.
Arc long décoré d'argent finement ouvragé. Porté par les archères Albinauriques chevaucheuses de loups.

items.name: Flowing Curved Sword
items.note: In a chest in a Great Coffin in the middle of the Consecrated Snowfield, southwest of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Found within the chest of the Enemy Caravan traveling the Consecrated Snowfield south-western area.
info: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water.
La légende parle d'un maître épéiste vêtu de bleu et de sa lame courbée censée représenter les mouvements de l'eau.

items.name: Golden Order Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by the Misbegotten Crusader at the end of the Cave of the Forlorn in the Consecrated Snowfield.
items.mapNote: Found inside Cave of the Forlorn. Dropped by Misbegotten Crusader
info: Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments.
Espadon de lumière représentant le Cercle d'Elden. Forgé par le roi consort Radagon afin de symboliser avec fierté les principes de l'Ordre d'or. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
items.note: Dropped by a Rotten Duelist west of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.
items.mapNote: Guaranteed drop from the Rotten Duelist enemy in the area
info: Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot.
Grand marteau de guerre en fer conçu pour les combats d'arène. Il est rongé par la putréfaction écarlate.

items.name: Rotten Greataxe
items.note: Dropped by a Rotten Duelist northwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the duelist enemy guarding the rear of Ordina, Liturgical Town
info: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot.
Grande hache conçue pour les combats d'arène. Elle est désormais rongée par la putréfaction écarlate.

items.name: St. Trina's Torch
items.note: In one of the Troll-drawn carriages in the southeast Snowfield, northeast of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.
items.mapNote: Looted from the treasure chest in the caravan wagon carted in the southern portion of Consecrated Ground in the northern lands.
info: Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carvings depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly.
Torche murale brûlant d'une flamme violacée. Les gravures qui l'ornent représentent sainte Trina, mais adulte, ce qui peut paraître troublant.

items.name: Cleanrot Spear
items.note: Drops from the spear-wielding Cleanrot Knights in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Closest is directly outside the "Prayer Room" Site of Grace (low drop rate).
info: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
Lance des chevaliers de la Noble putréfaction qui combattirent aux côtés de Malenia, épée de Miquella.

items.name: Loretta's War Sickle
items.note: Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree upon defeat.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
info: Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
Somptueuse faucille de guerre en argent maniée par Loretta, chevaleresse de l'Arbre-Sacré.

items.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
items.note: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree: Found atop a bell tower. From the Prayer Room site of grace, walk forward into the Haligtree.
items.mapNote: Found atop a belltower. You can reach this belltower by entering the second alcove on the left of the eastern walkway, heading up the stairs and then jumping onto the tree branch on the balcony. Follow the tree branch up and across to reach the tower.
info: Sword forged by servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber from the Haligtree is embedded in the blade.

Épée forgée par les serviteurs de Miquella de l'Arbre-Sacré. Semblable aux armes des chevaliers de Caria mais à la place de pierres d'éclat, ce sont des gouttes d'ambre de l'Arbre-Sacré qui décorent sa lame.

items.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
items.note: Possible drop from Misbegotten enemy, north of the Haligtree Town Plaza Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: There are flying enemies at the top of the castle. Thet may drop this weapon when killed.
info: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it.
Arc court auquel adhèrent des touffes de fourrure. Manié par les chimères ailées.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Spear
items.note: ation: Can be dropped by Lesser Crystalian enemies located within Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree 2 of them can be found in the room just next to the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace
info: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.
Lance conçue à partir de cristal pur. Elle est rongée par la putréfaction écarlate.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Staff
items.note: Drops from Putrid Crystalian Mages, e.g. near the Elphael Inner Wall grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
info: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.
Bâton conçu à partir de cristal pur et rongé par la putréfaction écarlate. Un ouvrage hors de portée pour un humain.
effect: Boosts Crystalian sorcery ; Causes slight scarlet rot buildup
Renforce les sorcelleries cristaliennes ; Accumule de la putréfaction écarlate

items.name: Rotten Crystal Sword
items.note: In a chest guarded by three Crystalians behind tree roots right after the Elphael Inner Wall grace in Elphael.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest guarded by 3 Crystalians. From the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, head down the steps and jump over the rubble on the left. You can engage the Crystalians one by one by luring them to the hallway.
info: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.
Épée conçue à partir de cristal pur. Elle est rongée par la putréfaction écarlate.

items.name: Rotten Staff
items.note: Dropped by the Putrid/scarlet-rot Erdtree Avatar patrolling the bridge in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar patrolling the ring walkway in the east.
info: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot.
Bâton de cérémonie représentant l'Arbre-Monde et son rayonnement historique. Il est rongé par la putréfaction écarlate.

items.name: Beastman's Cleaver
items.note: Drops from cleaver-wielding Beastmen in Crumbling Farum Azula; also from a Beastman at the Four Belfries Crumbling Lands waygate.
info: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.
Espadon courbé colossal forgé à partir de fer brut, manié par les hommes-bêtes de Farum Azula.

items.name: Beastman's Curved Sword
items.note: Drops from curved-sword-wielding Azula Beastmen, e.g. the seven near the Crumbling Beast Grave Site of Grace.
info: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.
Épée courbée forgée à partir de fer brut, utilisée par les hommes-bêtes de Farum Azula.

items.name: Cinquedea
items.note: On a body far down the cliff west of the Bestial Sanctum, on the same level as the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman.
items.mapNote: Found outside the bestial sanctum, after a long series of platforms starting on the west side to drop down onto the external structure's base.
info: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations.
Épée courte attribuée aux prêtres de haut rang de Farum Azula. Augmente la puissance des incantations bestiales.

items.name: Devourer's Scepter
items.note: Dropped by Knight Bernahl when killed - either at the Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave or during his invasion in Crumbling Farum Azula.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.
info: Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments.
Sceptre représentant un serpent engloutissant le monde. Cette arme vint à symboliser le seigneur du blasphème. L'une des armes légendaires.

items.name: Wing of Astel
items.note: a small chest at the top of the ruins in southern Uhl Palace Ruins. Can only be reached if you have access to the northern section of Ainsel River, by following the river east from northern Uhl Palace Ruins.
info: Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light.
Épée conçue à partir d'une aile diaphane imprégnée de la magie des étoiles. Les attaques puissantes projettent une vague de lumière enchantée.

items.name: Alabaster Lord's Sword
items.note: Drops from the Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot (raise the platforms near the end of the lake and climb the cliff west of the Grand Cloister); a second drops from the Alabaster Lord in Yelough Anix Tunnel.
info: Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.
Espadon conçu à partir d'un minerai météorique bleu et blanc. Sa lame renferme un pouvoir permettant de contrôler les forces gravitationnelles.

items.name: Dragonscale Blade
items.note: Drops from Dragonkin Soldier in the Lake of Rot.
info: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade.
Lame translucide conçue à l'aide d'une écaille de granite de laquelle les dragons anciens tireraient leur immortalité.

items.name: Scorpion's Stinger
items.note: In a chest in a small shrine west of the Grand Cloister grace at the Lake of Rot, guarded by Kindred of Rot.
info: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot.
Dague réalisée à partir de la queue d'un grand scorpion ruisselante de putréfaction écarlate.

items.name: Iron Spear
items.note: Dropped by spear-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers near the Nokron, Eternal City grace.
info: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.
Lance en fer des plus ordinaire. Sa lame est couverte de rouille.

items.name: Nox Flowing Hammer
items.note: On a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, Nokron, near the Mimic Tear Ashes.
info: Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City.
Masse en forme de gouttelette portée par les moines de la Ville éternelle.

items.name: Clayman's Harpoon
items.note: Dropped by Clayman at Uhl Palace Ruins, Siofra River or Ainsel River.
info: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains.
Harpon dont la pointe est constituée d'un fragment de météorite affûté. Manié par les boueux qui infestent les décombres d'une dynastie déchue.

items.name: Dragon Halberd
items.note: Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in Siofra River
info: Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning.
Hallebarde imitant la forme d'un dragon, imprégnée à la fois de glace et de foudre.

items.name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle in Siofra Aqueduct when both bosses are defeated.
info: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Espadon en bronze manié par les gargouilles vaillantes.

items.name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
items.note: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss (Nokron), along with the Gargoyle's Greatsword.
info: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Lame double en bronze maniée par les gargouilles vaillantes.

items.name: Ghostflame Torch
items.note: On a corpse on the rooftops near the entrance of Nokron, Eternal City (two running jumps from the parapets).
info: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.

Torche brûlant d'une flamme spectrale glaciale. Appartenant aux Faucons impétueux qui rôdent près des rivières souterraines. Lorsque la bande eut épuisé toutes ses braises, ses membres commencèrent à brûler les os de leurs compagnons, créant ainsi une flamme spectrale glaciale, mais scellant leur destin pour l'éternité, les condamnant à ne plus jamais quitter les souterrains.

items.name: Greathorn Hammer
items.note: Drops from Ancestral Follower Warriors that wield it (concentrated around Siofra River / the Ancestral Woods).
info: Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors.
Corne énorme et épaisse portant des marques évoquant les cernes d'un arbre, façonnée pour servir d'arme contondante. Maniée par les guerriers des disciples ancestraux.

items.name: Horn Bow
items.note: a corpse in Siofra River near Siofra River Bank Site of Grace, under the stairs leading to Hallowhorn Grounds.
info: Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by the master hunters of the ancestral followers.
Arc long sculpté dans une corne d'animal. Porté par les chasseurs d'élite des disciples ancestraux. Imprègne les flèches de magie.

items.name: Inseparable Sword
items.note: Guaranteed drop after the death of D, Beholder of Death, in the Siofra Aqueduct (or Deeproot Depths, depending on the questline path).
info: Sword forged by compounding silver and gold. A sacred weapon to hunt Those Who Live in Death. Deals holy damage.
Épée forgée à partir d'un mélange d'argent et d'or. Une arme sacrée conçue pour traquer les non-morts. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Jawbone Axe
items.note: Drops from axe-wielding Ancestral Follower Warriors, e.g. northwest of Worshippers' Woods in lower Siofra River.
info: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal.
Hache réalisée à partir du crâne d'un herbivore. Cette arme est employée par les disciples ancestraux, qui méprisent le métal.

items.name: Shotel
items.note: Sold by the Abandoned Merchant in lower Siofra River (west of Worshippers' Woods) for 2,500 Runes.
info: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.
Épée courbée à la lame fortement crochue, capable de trouver une faille dans la garde d'un ennemi.

items.name: Varre's Bouquet
items.note: Drops from White Mask Varre at the end of his questline; touch his invasion sign near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint grace and defeat him, then exhaust his dialogue.
info: A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood.
Masse en acier ressemblant à un charmant bouquet de roses. Chaque pétale est doté d'un bord tranchant abreuvant constamment les fleurs de sang frais.

items.name: Prince of Death's Staff
items.note: ng location: From The Nameless Eternal City site of grace in Deeproot Depths, head east and you'll see a root ramp and a series rooftops forming a ramp
items.fr: Bâton du Prince de la Mort
info: Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries.
Bâton incrusté d'ambre souillé, qui aurait été arraché au corps même du Prince de la Mort. Renforce les sorcelleries de mort.

items.name: Siluria's Tree
items.note: Dropped by Crucible Knight Siluria in Deeproot Depths.
info: Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights.
L'Arbre de Siluria, arme de l'un des deux chevaliers du Creuset les plus célèbres.

items.name: Staff of the Avatar
items.note: Dropped by an Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest grace in Deeproot Depths.
info: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
Bâton de cérémonie représentant l'Arbre-Monde et son rayonnement historique, manié par les avatars protégeant les Arbres-Monde mineurs.

items.name: Bone Bow
items.note: At the bottom of the spiral-staircase tower at the northwestern edge of Belurat, guarded by two giant Spider Scorpions.
info: A crude shortbow fashioned from sickly bone.
Arc court grossier façonné à partir d'os abimés.

items.name: Curseblade's Cirque
items.note: Drops from Curseblades; an easy one walks down the stairs from the Stagefront Site of Grace in Belurat. Also in Gravesite Plain, Scadu Altus and Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
info: Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss.
Arme des Exécrables masqués. Lame-revers circulaire dont le tranchant irrégulier et pointu permet de faire saigner les adversaires.

items.name: Euporia
items.note: Reached in Belurat/Enir-Ilim by dropping off the path past the lightning Divine Beast Warrior down to a balcony, then following the lifts past the Inquisitors and Divine Beast Warrior.
info: Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower.
Lame double représentant l'abondance. Le trésor caché de la tour.

items.name: Horned Warrior's Sword
items.note: Drops from Horned Warriors who wield them (an easy one to farm is located just up the stairs from the Small Private Altar Site of Grace in Belurat, Tower Settlement
info: Curved sword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower.
Épée courbée des guerriers cornus, gardiens de la tour.

items.name: Poisoned Hand
items.note: Sewer Level of the Belurat Tower Settlement in Gravesite Plain.
info: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with deadly poison. Raises attack power when poisoning occurs in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who have had everything burned or stolen from them, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

Gant fait de morceaux de peau écorchée prélevée sur les victimes d'un atroce bain de sang. Accumule du poison chez les cibles. Augmente la puissance d'attaque en cas d'empoisonnement causé à proximité. Nées d'un sombre et implacable désir de vengeance nourri par ceux qui furent traqués tels des hérétiques par leurs semblables, ces armes sont le dernier recours des opprimés.

items.name: Dane's Footwork
items.note: Pillaged from Dryleaf Dane's corpse after the Miquellan Loyalists / Leda and allies boss fight in Enir-Ilim.
info: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques.
Technique de combat rapproché à mains nues. Cet art martial repose sur des techniques de coups de pied.

items.name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by the wind-aspected Divine Beast Warrior near the end of Enir-Ilim, on the bridge to the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom grace.
info: Curved greatsword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. A heavy weapon made to bring the deft strength of the warriors to bear.
Espadon courbé des guerriers cornus, gardiens de la tour. Une arme lourde conçue pour tirer parti de la force et l'adresse de son porteur.

items.name: Leda's Sword
items.note: Received after defeating Leda and her allies near the top of Enir-Ilim.
info: Light greatsword with gold inlaid.  Weapon of Leda, the Needle Knight. Deals holy damage.
Espadon léger incrusté de dorures. L'arme de Leda, chevaleresse de l'Aiguille. Inflige des dégâts sacrés.

items.name: Obsidian Lamina
items.note: Recovered from Sir Ansbach's body near the Promised Consort Radahn arena, after assisting him against Leda at the Specimen Storehouse.
info: Signature weapon of the Pureblood Knight Ansbach. A viciously keen and slender scythe made for combat.
Arme emblématique du chevalier de sang pur Ansbach. Une faux effilée et acérée conçue pour les combats.

items.name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle
items.note: Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.
info: Concealed weapon used by Thiollier, of a design generally favored by poison-wielders for dark and subtle purposes.
Arme secrète de Thiollier, semblable à celles privilégiées par les utilisateurs de poison pour mener à bien et en toute discrétion leurs basses besognes.
effect: Provoque une accumulation de sommeil éternel

items.name: Ansbach's Longbow
items.note: Kill or assist Sir Ansbach during Needle Knight Leda's questline in Shadow Keep.
info: Weapon of Sir Ansbach. A longbow consisting of two bow bodies and two strings.
L'arme de sire Ansbach. Un arc long formé de deux corps et de deux cordes.

items.name: Fire Knight's Greatsword
items.note: 4.0% Chance to be dropped by Fire Knights that wield it in the Shadow Keep.
info: Greatsword of the Fire Knights. A long, slender blade that undulates like fire.
Espadon des chevaliers de Feu. Sa longue lame effilée ondule telle une flamme.

items.name: Fire Knight's Seal
items.note: Shadow Keep: In the building with the giant Queen Marika statue, it is behind the statue. You have to use the lever to lower the water level.
info: Sacred seal of the Fire Knights, who answer directly to Messmer the Impaler.
Sceau sacré des chevaliers de Feu, sous le commandement direct de Messmer l'Empaleur. Améliore les incantations de feu de Messmer.
effect: Améliore les incantations de flamme de Messmer

items.name: Freyja's Greatsword
items.note: Dropped by Redmane Freyja - after the Leda and allies boss fight at the Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) / Enir-Ilim, or near the Storehouse, Seventh Floor grace.
info: Weapon of Freyja, a Redmane. Greatsword decorated with a mane, much like the weapons used by her liege.
Arme de Freyja, chevaleresse du Lion rouge. À l'instar de l'armement de son seigneur, les motifs ornant cet espadon évoquent une crinière.

items.name: Main-gauche
items.note: On a body in a small room with a Black Knight, up the western stairs from the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace.
info: Dagger with a large hand guard.
Dague munie d'une large garde.

items.name: Queelign's Greatsword
items.note: Obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation.
info: Greatsword of the Fire Knight Queelign. A weighty piercing sword with a blade that undulates like fire.
Espadon du chevalier de Feu Queelign. Lourde épée perçante dont la lame ondule telle une flamme.

items.name: Backhand Blade
items.note: Beside a coffin, in the Inquisitor enemies' area of Gravesite Plain, northeast from the Scorched Ruins site of grace.
info: Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip. A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations.
Lame courbée conçue pour être tenue à l'envers.

items.name: Beast Claw
items.note: Dropped by Logur, the Beast Claw, in the southern part of Gravesite Plain on the way to the Church of Consolation.
info: Weapon in the form of a carnivorous beast's vicious claws. Used to perform bestial slashing attacks uncanny to humankind.
Arme ressemblant aux griffes tranchantes d'une bête carnivore. Permet d'effectuer des attaques de taille avec une sauvagerie bestiale inouïe pour un être humain.

items.name: Black Steel Greathammer
items.note: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the Church of Consolation.
info: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Greathammer of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power. Guard Counters cause a burst of power.
Arme des chevaliers noirs, au service de Messmer l'Empaleur. Ce grand marteau en acier noir est paré d'ornements dorés.

items.name: Bloodfiend's Arm
items.note: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.
info: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. An arm pulled from the corpse of one of their kin, and wielded as a makeshift weapon.
Arme employée par les démons sanglants. Il s'agit simplement d'un bras arraché à la dépouille d'un de leurs semblables et brandi comme arme improvisée.

items.name: Bloodfiend's Fork
items.note: Random drop from Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure and Rauh Base.
info: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss.
Arme en os à trois dents employée par les démons sanglants. Elle cause des saignements en transperçant ses victimes.

items.name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle
items.note: Purchased from Thiollier for 6,000 Runes (or later from Moore / the Twin Maiden Husks).
items.fr: Flacon de parfum de poison mortel
info: Perfume bottle customized by Thiollier.
Flacon de parfum personnalisé par Thiollier. Cette arme libère une poudre fragrante empoisonnée.

items.name: Death Knight's Twin Axes
items.note: Dropped by the dual-axe Death Knight at the end of Fog Rift Catacombs.
items.fr: Haches jum. du chevalier de la Mort
info: Golden war axes of the Death Knight. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
Haches de guerre dorées du chevalier de la Mort. Paire d'armes conçues pour être maniées ensemble.

items.name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
items.note: Received for defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the Dragon's Pit dungeon.
items.fr: Grand katana de chasseur de dragon
info: Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect.
Grand katana dont la lame est surmontée de pierres tranchantes. Une arme portée par l'homme-dragon ancien de la Fosse au dragon. Dispose d'un effet anti-dragon.

items.name: Firespark Perfume Bottle
items.note: In a chest in the southeastern corner of the military encampment by the Castle Front Site of Grace.
info: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.
Flacon de parfum transformé en arme par des Parfumeurs du Royaume des ombres. Cette poudre fragrante libère des étincelles de feu.

items.name: Great Katana
items.note: Gravesite Plain: The Great Katana can be found next to the sleeping Ghostflame Dragon on the lake, west of the Abandoned Ailing Village site of grace.
info: Large katana with a prominent tempering pattern on its black blade, unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. The most finely honed of its ilk.
Grand katana portant un motif bien visible sur sa lame noire, caractéristique des guerriers des Terres des roseaux. Il s'agit de l'instrument le plus prestigieux de sa catégorie.

items.name: Greatsword of Solitude
items.note: Dropped by the Knight of the Solitary Gaol inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum.
info: Steel greatsword wielded by the Knights of the Solitary Gaol.
Espadon des chevaliers de la Geôle Solitaire.

items.name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
items.note: In a small pond surrounded by Lightning Sheep southeast of the Ellac River Downstream grace / northeast of the Cerulean Coast grace.
info: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.
Flacon de parfum transformé en arme par des Parfumeurs du Royaume des ombres. Cette arme libère une poudre fragrante générant de la foudre.

items.name: Lizard Greatsword
items.note: Drops from greatsword-wielding lion-headed Imps in Fog Rift Catacombs (and Scorpion River Catacombs).
info: A peculiar weapon carried by imps. Greatsword smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued lizard.
Curieuse arme maniée par les diablotins. Le créateur de cet espadon lui a donné la forme d'un lézard à la langue fourchue.

items.name: Messmer Soldier's Axe
items.note: Drops from axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers; e.g. at Fog Rift Fort or outside Castle Ensis at the Castle Front grace.
info: Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A steel axe, worn from use.
Arme employée par les soldats de Messmer l'Empaleur. Cette hache en acier porte moult traces d'usure.

items.name: Milady
items.note: In a chest atop a watchtower in Castle Ensis, reached by dropping from the Castle-Lord's Chamber balcony down the rock faces, then up stairs and ladders.
info: Though its blade is of standard greatsword length, its weight has been whittled away to the absolute minimum. Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.

Bien que cette arme possède une lame aussi longue que celle d'un espadon, son poids a été réduit autant que possible. Son apparence raffinée lui a valu ce surnom, rendant hommage aux dames nobles. Avec un entraînement adéquat, il est possible de manier cette arme aussi rapidement qu'une épée droite.

items.name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword
items.note: Dropped by Moonrithyll, Carian Knight, who invades on the path between the Castle Ensis Checkpoint and Castle-Lord's Chamber graces.
info: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. The favored weapon of the steadfast Carian knight, Moonrithyll.
Espadon serti d'une pierre d'éclat bleue. Arme favorite de Lunerithyll, indéfectible chevaleresse de Caria.

items.name: Pata
items.note: On a corpse on a ledge by the front entrance to the Church of Benediction.
info: A weapon comprised of a linear, double-sided blade attached to a substantial guard. Wielded by the Oathseeker Knights.
Arme composée d'une lame droite à double tranchant fixée sur une garde imposante. Arme des Quêteurs de serment.

items.name: Serpent Flail
items.note: In a chest within Fog Rift Fort.
info: A flail with coiled snakes for bludgeoning heads. Fire roars within the snakes' bodies, inflicting horrible burns.
Fléau orné de serpents entrelacés. Une arme idéale pour fracasser des crânes. Le feu palpitant qui habite le corps des serpents inflige de terribles brûlures.

items.name: Spirit Glaive
items.note: On a grave at the edge of Gravesite Plain; from Charo's Hidden Grave, go through the northwest arch, turn right, and follow the path up north.
info: Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A glaive that has seen many years of use in the gravesite.
Lame acérée à la forme noueuse. Cette vouge a connu bien des années de service au cimetière.

items.name: Spread Crossbow
