items.note: On a corpse in a ruined campsite by the cliffs facing the Ellac River, south of the Castle Front encampment.
info: A modified crossbow made by combining two crossbows into one.
Arbalète modifiée conçue à partir de deux arbalètes combinées.

items.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
items.note: Found at an altar in Fog Rift Catacombs (or Ruins of Unte / Ancient Ruins of Rauh).
info: A sword that none can pull from its scabbard of cracked stone.
Épée impossible à extraire de son fourreau de pierre craquelée.

items.name: Swift Spear
items.note: On a corpse guarded by three Messmer Soldiers along the road southeast of the Castle Front Site of Grace.
info: A metal-bodied spear of extremely lightweight make, being the result of a sophisticated molding technique.
Lance intégralement faite d'un métal très léger, produit d'une technique de moulage sophistiquée.

items.name: Sword of Darkness
items.note: Transform the Stone-Sheathed Sword (or Sword of Light) at the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte.
info: Sword of darkness, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar.
Épée de ténèbres extraite de son fourreau de pierre à un autel.

items.name: Sword of Light
items.note: Transform the Stone-Sheathed Sword at the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
info: Sword of light, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar.
Épée de lumière, extraite de son fourreau de pierre à un autel.

items.name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
items.note: Examine the altar in Ruined Forge Starfall Past; pull the lever to raise the iron door and jump across to the second level where the altar sits.
info: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. Greatsword of ancient meteoric ore, ending in a sharp point.
Un des trésors trouvés dans les forges en ruines. Espadon formé de minerai météorique ancien, dont l'extrémité est acérée.

items.name: Barbed Staff-Spear
items.note: Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor in the Darklight Catacombs.
info: Greatstaff of Jori, elder inquisitor. The tip bristles with golden barbs symbolic of the inquisition's torture, allowing one to wield the staff as a greatspear.
Grand bâton de Jori, inquisiteur en chef. Son extrémité est hérissée d'aiguillons dorés caractéristiques de la torture pratiquée par l'inquisition, permettant de le manier comme une grande lance.

items.name: Black Steel Twinblade
items.note: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the western hill camp beside the encampment in front of Shadow Keep (northeast of Church of the Crusade).
info: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Twinblade of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.
Arme employée par les chevaliers noirs, au service de Messmer l'Empaleur. Cette lame double en acier noir est parée d'ornements dorés.

items.name: Bonny Butchering Knife
items.note: Loot below a small shed outside a house east of the Bonny Village Site of Grace, just west of the broken bridge in the central ravine.
info: Weapon of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. An outsize butcher's cleaver used to dismember human bodies in the making of the great jars stored in the gaols.
Arme des grands potentats du village de Bonny. Ce fendoir de boucher démesuré sert à dépecer des corps humains afin de remplir les grandes jarres gardées dans les geôles.

items.name: Carian Sorcery Sword
items.note: In a chest that can be found after dropping down into Castle Ensis from the cliff just west of the waterfall to the west of the Highroad Cross Site of Grace in Scadu Altus.
info: One of the Carian royal family's glintstone swords. A smaller piercing sword with a slender blade. Formerly used by the Carian knights of old before the full refinement of their sorcerous combat techniques, this armament functions as a catalyst for glintstone sorcery when executing strong attacks.
Une épée en pierre d'éclat appartenant à la famille royale de Caria. Cette arme perçante est dotée d'une lame effilée.

items.name: Dryleaf Arts
items.note: Won from Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel at the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace (perform the 'May the Best Win' gesture before him).
info: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks.
Technique de combat rapproché à mains nues. Cet art martial combine à la fois coups de pied et de poing.

items.name: Dryleaf Seal
items.note: On a cliff facing the river north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace.
info: Sacred seal of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Enhances incantations which conjure golden rings of light.

Sceau sacré des chercheurs spirituels formant la secte de Mortefeuille. Améliore les incantations qui conjurent des halos de lumière dorée. Ceux qui avaient autrefois entrevu le déclin de l'Arbre-Monde dans la chute de ses feuilles s'étaient préparés à l'affaiblissement de l'Ordre. Ils adoptèrent alors une foi stricte, avant de commencer à vénérer une nouvelle divinité.
effect: Boosts golden ring of light incantations
Améliore les incant. conjurant des halos de lumière dorée

items.name: Falx
items.note: Guaranteed drop from Hornsent (hostile NPC) - looted near the Rauh Ancient Ruins Site of Grace or after Leda's boss fight in Shadow Keep / Ancient Ruins of Rauh / Enir-Ilim.
info: Curved swords with long, sickle-like blades. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands.
Épées courbées aux longues lames semblables à des faux. Paire d'armes conçues pour être maniées ensemble.

items.name: Forked-Tongue Hatchet
items.note: Drops from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps; earliest in Darklight Catacombs (also Fog Rift and Scorpion River Catacombs).
info: A peculiar weapon wielded by imps. Hatchet smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued dragon.
Curieuse arme maniée par les diablotins. Hachette forgée en lui donnant la forme d'un dragon à la langue fourchue.

items.name: Messmer Soldier's Spear
items.note: Drops from spear-wielding Messmer Soldiers; three are at a camp west of the Moorth Ruins grace.
info: Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a steel blade worn from use.
Arme employée par les soldats au service de Messmer l'Empaleur. Grande lance munie d'une lame en acier fort usée.

items.name: Rabbath's Cannon
items.note: In the study of Rabbath's Rise; reach it via a nearby Sealed Spiritspring or by descending from the cliffs southeast of Shaman Village.
info: A type of jar cannon used to fire greatbolts. A masterwork of Spellmachinist Rabbath.
Sorte de jarre en forme de canon permettant de tirer de grands carreaux. Un chef-d'œuvre du Machinicien Rabbath.

items.name: Rakshasa's Great Katana
items.note: Dropped by Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.
info: A great katana with the tempering pattern of its blade forever stained red with blood. Weapon of Rakshasa, who cuts down and devours.
Grand katana dont le motif de la lame est à jamais taché de sang. L'arme de Rakshasa, qui tranche et dévore.

items.name: Repeating Crossbow
items.note: Alongside the road just south of the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South grace, southwest of Moorth Ruins.
info: A mechanized crossbow that has been fitted with a fan-shaped contraption.
Arbalète mécanique dotée d'un appareil en forme d'éventail.

items.name: Smithscript Cirque
items.note: On a body by the sewage waterfall in the depths of Ruined Forge of Starfall Past, behind a lever-locked gate.
info: Circular backhand blade engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.
Lame-revers circulaire portant une inscription forgegraphe. Une arme de lancer créée grâce aux arts de la forge.

items.name: Smithscript Spear
items.note: On a body on the main floor of Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.
info: Spear engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.
Lance porteuse d'une inscription forgegraphe. Cette arme de jet est l'œuvre d'un artisan de talent.

items.name: Tooth Whip
items.note: On a corpse inside the Whipping Hut in Scadu Altus.
info: Whip bestrewn with rotting, misshapen teeth. Filthy and seething with disease, the teeth are embedded in the whip and dose the victim with deadly poison upon each strike.
Fouet garni de dents cariées et déformés. Les dents sont incrustées dans le fouet et injectent à la victime un poison mortel à chaque coup.

items.name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle
items.note: On a seated corpse by the northern wall of the Church Ruins (Abandoned Church) in the Abyssal Woods.
items.fr: Flacon de parfum de la Flamme exaltée
info: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.
Flacon de parfum transformé en arme par des Parfumeurs du Royaume des ombres. Cette arme libère une poudre fragrante de la Flamme exaltée.

items.name: Madding Hand
items.note: Dropped by an unmarked optional boss south of the Woodland Trail grace in the Abyssal Woods.
info: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with madness. Raises attack power when madness is triggered in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who were hunted down as heretics by their own brethren, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

Gant fait de morceaux de peau écorchée prélevée sur les victimes d'un atroce bain de sang. Accumule de la démence chez les cibles. Augmente la puissance d'attaque en cas de démence causée à proximité. Nées d'un sombre et implacable désir de vengeance nourri par ceux qui furent traqués tels des hérétiques par leurs semblables, ces armes sont le dernier recours des opprimés.

items.name: Nanaya's Torch
items.note: On a body inside Midra's Manse; from Midra's Library grace, cross the rafters west and pull the lever behind an illusory painting.
info: A torch made by attaching a dying flame of frenzy to a small spinal column.
Torche réalisée en fichant une Flamme exaltée mourante sur une petite colonne vertébrale.

items.name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
items.note: In Lamenter's Gaol (accessed from Charo's Hidden Grave): open the first locked door with the Upper Gaol Key, descend the ladder onto the frozen floor; in the room a Jar Innards emerges from.
info: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.
Flacon de parfum transformé en arme par des Parfumeurs du Royaume des ombres. Cette arme libère une poudre fragrante d'un froid glacial.

items.name: Lamenting Visage
items.note: In Lamenter's Gaol (from Charo's Hidden Grave): from the Living Jar Warrior pit, take the first door left, pass an illusory wall, and open the locked door with the Gaol Lower Level Key.
info: A stone lantern carved to resemble a lamenting human head, the eyes vacantly beaming out light. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.
Lanterne de pierre sculptée à l'effigie d'une tête humaine geignarde, dont les orbites émettent de la lumière. Si vous l'équipez en main gauche, vous pouvez la lever pour mieux vous éclairer.

items.name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear
items.note: Picked up after defeating a Bloodfiend Hexer in the small pond west of Taylew's Ruined Forge in Rauh Base.
info: Greatspear of the bloodfiend hexers. One of the most significant implements used in their blood rituals.
Grande lance employée par les envoûteurs des démons sanglants. Elle occupe un rôle central lors des rituels de sang les plus sanctifiés.

items.name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe
items.note: Dropped by the Death Knight at Scorpion River Catacombs.
items.fr: Hache longue du chevalier de la Mort
info: A long-hafted golden axe wielded by the Death Knight. Bears a representation of a decayed golden ring. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.
Hache dorée à long manche maniée par le chevalier de la Mort. Ornée d'une représentation de cercle doré corrodé.
skill: Charge fulminante : hache à long manche

items.name: Golem Fist
items.note: Random drop from Golem Smiths at Taylew's Ruined Forge, Rauh Base.
info: A giant fist of fractured rock. Taken from the body of a golem of the ruined forges.
Imposant poing de roche fracturée, arraché au cadavre d'un golem des forges en ruines.

items.name: Red Bear's Claw
items.note: Dropped by the Red Bear NPC boss in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum (accessed via Rauh Base).
info: Claw of a great red bear wielded without modification by Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness.
Griffe d'un grand ursidé roux maniée telle quelle par l'ours écarlate, dont le véritable nom fut effacé par la folie.

items.name: Smithscript Axe
items.note: In a room with a Golem Smith reached by jumping the gap on the straight path from the Taylew's Ruined Forge grace, then taking a left.
info: Axe engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.
Hache porteuse d'une inscription forgegraphe. Cette arme de jet est l'œuvre d'un artisan de talent.

items.name: Smithscript Greathammer
items.note: Found at Taylew's Ruined Forge, Rauh Base.
info: Greathammer engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.
Grand marteau porteur d'une inscription forgegraphe. Cette arme de jet est l'œuvre d'un artisan de talent.

items.name: Spiraltree Seal
items.note: Reward from 'The Sacred Tower' painting; after burning the Sealing Tree past the Church of the Bud, the painter relocates south of the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.
info: Sacred seal of soiled amber engraved with a spiral tree design.
Sceau sacré fait à partir d'ambre souillé et gravé d'un motif d'arbre entortillé. Améliore les incantations spiralées.

items.name: Anvil Hammer
items.note: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake.
info: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. A tremendous hammer that incorporates as its head the red-hot anvil of the forge.
Un des trésors trouvés dans les forges en ruines. La tête de ce gigantesque marteau n'est autre qu'une enclume incandescente.

items.name: Flowerstone Gavel
items.note: Where the Dragon Communion Priestess stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated (if you did not give her Thiollier's Concoction).
info: Weapon of the Dragon Communion priestess. A dragonstone hammer resembling an ancient flower.
Arme de la prêtresse de la communion draconique. Ce marteau en pierre draconique évoque une fleur antique.

items.name: Igon's Greatbow
items.note: Recovered from Igon's corpse after completing his questline or killing him (notably on Jagged Peak after the Bayle fight).
info: Weapon of Igon, the broken drake warrior. A greatbow fashioned from two dragon bones bound with coarse rope. Covered in gashes left by claws.
L'arme d'Igon, le guerrier draconique brisé. Un arc géant conçu à partir de deux os de dragon maintenus par une corde rudimentaire. Couvert de griffures.

items.name: Smithscript Dagger
items.note: Behind the Golem Smith on the floor below the lava-pipe lever in Ruined Forge Lava Intake.
info: Dagger engraved with a smithscript.
Dague portant une inscription forgegraphe. Son poids moindre améliore les effets des arts de la forge, ce qui permet à cette arme de faire office de dagues de lancer à chaque attaque.

items.name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
items.note: Dropped by the Dancer of Ranah inside the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.
info: Decorative swords ablaze with impassioned red. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands.
Épées d'apparat garnies de riches tissus rouges. Paire d'armes conçues pour être maniées ensemble.

items.name: Spirit Sword
items.note: In a ravine behind the stranded coffin boat northeast of the Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace, in the far right corner near gravestones.
info: Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A sword that has seen many years of use in the gravesite.
Lame acérée à la forme noueuse. Cette épée a connu bien des années de service au cimetière.

items.name: Star-Lined Sword
items.note: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga, who can be found in the Cerulean Coast starting from Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace to follow the path northeast populated with demi-humans..
info: Sword encrusted with a line of stars fashioned from small pieces of crude glintstone. Weapon of the demi-human swordsmen.
Épée incrustée d'une ligne d'étoiles sculptées dans de petits morceaux de pierre d'éclat brute. Arme des épéistes semi-humains.

items.name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina
items.note: Furthest inside a slime-filled cave south of the Fissure Cross Site of Grace (drop down two stone platforms to a lower cliff).
items.fr: Épée de velours de sainte Trina
info: Silver sword of St. Trina, now stained the color of velvet. Inflicts eternal sleep.
Épée en argent de sainte Trina, qui a désormais pris la couleur du velours. Plonge ses victimes dans un sommeil éternel.
effect: Provoque une accumulation de sommeil éternel

items.name: Claws of Night
items.note: Dropped by the invading Swordhand of Night Anna on the approach to the hanging bell of the Finger Ruins (Finger Ruins of Rhia).
info: Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night.

Griffes d'un noir si profond qu'il ne renvoie aucune lumière, maniées par l'épéiste nocturne Anna. Elles portent une inscription forgegraphe, qui permet de lancer les trois griffes sur sa cible avec une attaque puissante. Puisque ces armes ne sont pas entièrement tangible, leurs dégâts ne peuvent pas être totalement bloqués.

items.name: Maternal Staff
items.note: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers, in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, after slaying Metyr, Mother of Fingers.
info: Staff of Count Ymir, who made himself a Mother of Fingers. Carried for want of tail-fingers of his own. Enhances finger sorceries.
Bâton du comte Ymir, qui décida de devenir une mère des Doigts. Une arme portée à défaut de posséder une queue faite de doigts. Améliore les sorcelleries des Doigts.

items.name: Sword of Night
items.note: Dropped by Jolan, Swordhand of Night, at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after Count Ymir's questline - give her the Iris of Occultation.
info: Sword of an all-consuming, bottomless black that devours even the light that shines upon it. Wielded by Jolán, Swordhand of Night.
Épée d'un noir absolu qui dévore la lumière même et n'émet aucun reflet. Portée par l'épéiste nocturne Jolán.

items.name: Devonia's Hammer
items.note: Dropped by Devonia, Crucible Knight near Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Grace.
info: Great hammer wielded by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights.
Grand marteau brandi par Devonia, la plus ancienne vétérane des chevaliers du Creuset.

items.name: Chainlink Flail
items.note: Dropped by Mad Pumpkin Head enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).
info: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads.
Tube en fer pourvu de pics reliés à une chaîne, d'ordinaire manié par les têtes de citrouille démentes.

items.name: Curved Club
items.note: Chance to drop from Albinauric enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).
info: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon.
Gourdin courbé en forme de croissant de lune.

items.name: Envoy's Greathorn
items.note: Chance to drop from Giant Oracle Envoy enemies (no single fixed location).
info: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.
Corne dorée en éventail des émissaires de l'oracle. Son poids lui permet d'asséner des frappes dévastatrices.

items.name: Envoy's Horn
items.note: Dropped by Oracle Envoy enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).
info: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.
Corne dorée des émissaires de l'oracle. Son poids lui permet d'asséner des frappes dévastatrices.

items.name: Envoy's Long Horn
items.note: Dropped by large Oracle Envoy enemies (no single fixed location).
info: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.
Longue corne dorée des émissaires de l'oracle. Son poids lui permet d'asséner des frappes dévastatrices.

items.name: Fire Knight's Shortsword
items.note: Drops from dual-dagger Fire Knights in the DLC (no single fixed location given).
items.fr: Épée courte de chevalier de Feu
info: Shortsword used by the Fire Knights. A slender blade that undulates like fire.
Épée courte utilisée par les chevaliers de Feu. Sa lame effilée ondule telle une flamme.

items.name: Grave Scythe
items.note: Drops from scythe-wielding Skeletons (no single fixed location).
info: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between.
Grande faux composée d'une lame imposante fixée à un bâton noueux. Arme portée par les vénérables gardiens qui veillent sur les cimetières oubliés de l'Entre-terre.

items.name: Guardian's Swordspear
items.note: ~2% drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies (no single fixed location).
info: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.
Arme constituée d'un long manche et d'une large lame affûtée, tous deux sculptés dans le bois dur d'arbres antiques.

items.name: Halo Scythe
items.note: Drops from Cleanrot Knights that wield it (no single fixed location given).
info: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
Faux de guerre des chevaliers de la Noble putréfaction qui combattirent aux côtés de Malenia, épée de Miquella.

items.name: Pest's Glaive
items.note: Chance to drop from Kindred of Rot enemies (no single fixed location).
info: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation.
Glaive réalisé à partir d'une carapace robuste et affûtée. Manié par les nuisibles qui émergèrent du marais d'Ivoine. Améliore la résistance aux dégâts non physiques.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.note: Drops from Miners in mining galleries throughout the Lands Between (no single fixed location).
info: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners.
Grande pioche conçue pour fendre les roches épaisses. Outil de mineurs endurcis.

items.name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
items.note: Dropped by Albinauric enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).
info: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics.
Arme maniée par les jeunes Albinauriques.

items.name: Spiked Club
items.note: Chance to drop from Demi-Human enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).
info: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss.
Gourdin à l'extrémité pourvue de crocs de bête. Sa morsure dentelée cause des saignements.

items.name: Stone Club
items.note: Chance to drop from Battlemage enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).
info: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power.
Arme typique des mages de bataille, faite de pierre d'éclat taillée. Ce gourdin est bien plus lourd que sa taille ne le laisse penser, mais est dépourvu de toute magie.

items.name: Unarmed
info: No armament equipped. Bare fists will be used to attack.
Aucune arme équipée. Vous attaquerez à mains nues.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Saw
items.note: Dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it (no single fixed location given).
info: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.
Arme de fantassin composée d'une lame de scie fixée à un long manche. Maniée par les miliciens vulgaires, son tranchant dentelé cause d'abondants saignements.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
items.note: Dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it (no single fixed location given).
info: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.
Lame crochue fixée à une longue hampe. Une arme de milicien vulgaire, capable de trouver une faille dans la garde d'un ennemi.

items.name: Heater Shield
items.note: Vagabond class starting equipment; purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 1,500 Runes.
info: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle.
Bouclier en métal classique de taille moyenne, relativement facile à manier.

items.name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
items.note: Inside a chest at a camp along the road west of the Saintsbridge Site of Grace in east Stormhill.
items.mapNote: A large shield kept inside a chest at a camp.
info: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
Bouclier en métal de taille moyenne. Plus facile d'utilisation qu'un rempart.

items.name: Blue-Gold Kite Shield
items.note: Can be bought from the Nomadic Merchant in East Limgrave for 1000 Runes.
info: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability.
Bouclier en métal classique de taille moyenne, très réputé pour sa robustesse et sa fiabilité.

items.name: Brass Shield
items.note: An easy early location to farm begins at the “Gatefront” Site of Grace in the western part of main Limgrave, just north of the forest and just before Stormgate. Once you spawn in, turn around to face south east.
items.mapNote: Found southeast of the map in Limgrave. Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Defeat it to obtain a Brass Shield.
info: On the larger side for a medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass.
Bouclier de taille moyenne particulièrement imposant, dont la surface a été couverte de cuivre.

items.name: Buckler
items.note: Bandit class starting equipment; also sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc at Stormveil and Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold.
info: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center is designed to parry.
Petit bouclier en métal. La bosse au milieu est conçue pour parer.

items.name: Gilded Greatshield
items.note: Drops from Godrick Knights; one is found at Gatefront Ruins.
info: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick.
Pavois en métal couvert d'un placage en or. Porté par les chevaliers fidèles à Godrick.

items.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
items.note: Dropped by the Grafted Scion in the Chapel of Anticipation (can be revisited later).
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.
info: Shield of dull gold with a beast engraved as its crest. Lighter than most greatshields, and subsequently easier to wield.
Bouclier d'or terne frappé d'un emblème de bête. Plus léger que la majorité des pavois et donc plus aisé à manier.

items.name: Horse Crest Wooden Shield
items.note: Purchased from Patches at Murkwater Cave for 1,000 Runes.
info: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle.
Bouclier en bois de taille moyenne, léger pour sa taille et facile à manier.

items.name: Iron Roundshield
items.note: Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave.
info: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
Petit bouclier rond en métal ordinaire. Plus lourd qu'un bouclier en bois, il confère une meilleure résistance aux dégâts.

items.name: Large Leather Shield
items.note: Purchased from Merchant Kale at the Church of Elleh for 600 Runes.
info: A roundshield covered in leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield.
Bouclier rond recouvert de cuir. Particulièrement imposant pour un bouclier de taille moyenne.

items.name: Lordsworn's Shield
items.note: Drops from Godrick Soldiers; several at Gatefront Ruins and on the path to Castleward Tunnel.
info: Wooden tower shield. Lightweight for a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering.
Égide en bois. Malgré sa taille, elle n'encombre que peu son porteur et se manie facilement. Régulièrement employée lors de l'Éclatement.

items.name: Riveted Wooden Shield
items.note: Bought from the Nomadic Merchant in East Limgrave for 600 Runes; Warrior class starting equipment.
info: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield.
Petit bouclier rond en bois renforcé avec des plaques de métal. Bien que léger et facile à manier, il n'encaisse pas aussi bien les dégâts qu'un véritable bouclier en métal.

items.name: Scripture Wooden Shield
items.note: Drops from skeletons near the start of Deathtouched Catacombs; Astrologer class starting equipment.
info: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield.
Petit bouclier rond en bois. Léger et facile d'utilisation, il ne peut cependant encaisser autant de dégâts qu'un bouclier en métal.

items.name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
items.note: On a stone platform on the cliffside southwest of Tombsward Catacombs, northwest of the minor Erdtree.
items.mapNote: Ledge of the pillar near Tombsward Site of Grace. Can be reached from the ledge near Minor Erdtree
info: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
Bouclier en métal de taille moyenne. Plus facile d'utilisation qu'un rempart.

items.name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
items.note: On a corpse inside a small shack on the north side of Ailing Village.
items.mapNote: You can loot the Flame Crest Wooden Shield from a naked commoner's corpse inside one of the cabins.
info: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Carried by soldiers of the village that is afflicted by frenzy.
Bouclier en bois de taille moyenne, léger pour sa taille et facile à manier. Porté par les soldats du village frappé de démence.

items.name: Gilded Iron Shield
items.note: On a corpse on a grave west of the Church of Pilgrimage.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse sitting on a grave in the graveyard.
info: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
Petit bouclier rond en métal. Plus lourd qu'un bouclier en bois, il confère une résistance aux dégâts supérieure.

items.name: Great Turtle Shell
items.note: Weeping Peninsula: From the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace, look towards the east to find a Spiritspring and use Torrent to jump from it towards the roof a tower section of the ramparts. The shield can be found on a corpse atop this tower.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse atop the eastern-most tower of the Castle Morne Ramparts. This area can be reached by using Torrent to jump from the Spiritspring located just east of the Site of Grace nearby.
info: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks.
Bouclier réalisé à partir d'une grande carapace de tortue. Ses aspérités naturelles aident à dévier les attaques ennemies.

items.name: Red Thorn Roundshield
items.note: Samurai class starting equipment; sold by a merchant on the eastern side of Weeping Peninsula for 600 Runes.
info: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield.
Petit bouclier rond en bois. Léger et facile d'utilisation, il ne peut cependant encaisser autant de dégâts qu'un bouclier en métal.

items.name: Rickety Shield
items.note: Drops from a group of Demi-Humans north of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.
info: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines.
Vieux bouclier en bois grinçant de forme circulaire et renforcé au moyen de lianes.

items.name: Round Shield
items.note: Bought from the Nomadic Merchant on the eastern side of Weeping Peninsula for 1,000 Runes.
info: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal.
Bouclier rond en bois renforcé avec du métal.

items.name: Shield of the Guilty
items.note: In the cellar of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins, before the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss.
items.mapNote: In the cellar area of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins, before the main building with the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss. You will need to jump over a wall to access the stairs leading into the cellar.
info: Shield made to venerate a maiden whose eyes were crushed by Briars of Sin before being reborn in these lands.
Bouclier réalisé en l'honneur d'une Servante qui renaquit dans ces contrées après avoir été sauvagement énucléée par les ronces du péché.

items.name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
items.note: Looted off a corpse in the large armory room next to the room with the Grafted Scion.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key to dispel the fog gate barring entry.
info: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle.
Bouclier en bois de taille moyenne, léger pour sa taille et facile à manier.

items.name: Manor Towershield
items.note: Stormveil Castle: From the Secluded Cell site of grace, backtrack to the west and up the ramp where the Living Jars are and turn around towards the wooden platform
items.mapNote: From the Secluded Cell site of grace, backtrack to the west and up the ramp where the Living Jars are and turn around towards the wooden platform. At the end of the platform, jump onto the ledge on the wall and follow it to the right towards some archways. Past the archways, enter the storage room on the right and head up the stairs to a walkway above. Head to the left towards a larger storage room full of Commoners. You can find the shield under the second set of stairs in this room.
info: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions.
Pavois en fer assez grand pour se cacher derrière. Son emblème représente le Bastion de la Table ronde, lieu de rassemblement des champions.

items.name: Marred Leather Shield
items.note: On a corpse along the wooden path up a slope from the Stormveil Cliffside grace (Gostoc's back route).
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse on a wooden platform, outside the castle walls.
info: Leather shield of Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns.
Bouclier de cuir des soldats de Voilorage. Comme pour faire écho au château, il est marbré et couvert de ronces.

items.name: Marred Wooden Shield
items.note: From the Rampart Tower grace, drop down to a ledge after the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks.
items.mapNote: From the Rampart Tower site of grace, exit onto the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks. Kill the War Hawk sitting on the western tower and then jump down the edge onto a ledge below. Follow the ledge north and jump down to the broken pillar below to find the shield.
info: Wooden shield of Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns.
Bouclier en bois des soldats de Voilorage. À l'instar du château, il est marbré et couvert de ronces.

items.name: Wooden Greatshield
items.note: Looted off a corpse on the guardhouse of the heavily guarded courtyard, near the Liftside Chamber grace.
items.mapNote: Found in a guardhouse near the northern section of the castle courtyard.
info: Wooden greatshield reinforced with a metal ornamentation.
Pavois en bois assez renforcé à l'aide d'une ornementation en métal.

items.name: Albinauric Shield
items.note: Drops from Albinaurics wielding it, found atop the church northwest of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace.
info: Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics. The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.
Grand bouclier ovale en métal porté par les jeunes Albinauriques. Ses ornements représentent la goutte de rosée primordiale qui aurait donné naissance à leur peuple.

items.name: Black Leather Shield
items.note: Sold by Pidia, Carian Servant at Caria Manor for 2,500 Runes.
info: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield.
Bouclier rond couvert de cuir noir. Particulièrement imposant pour un bouclier de taille moyenne.

items.name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant near Bellum Church in northwest Liurnia for 1,500 Runes; Confessor starting gear.
info: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
Bouclier en métal de taille moyenne. Plus facile d'utilisation qu'un rempart.

items.name: Blue-White Wooden Shield
items.note: On the outskirts of a building heading south from the South Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Shield in Academy Gate Town (near Raya Lucaria Academy Entrance). Can be found on the outskirts of the buildings, towards the west side.
info: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield.
Petit bouclier rond en bois renforcé avec des plaques de métal. Bien que léger et facile à manier, il n'encaisse pas aussi bien les dégâts qu'un véritable bouclier en métal.

items.name: Cuckoo Greatshield
items.note: Drops from Cuckoo Knights of Raya Lucaria; farmable around Bellum Church / East Raya Lucaria Gate.
info: Metal greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy.
Pavois en métal orné d'un coucou aux aguets. Porté par les chevaliers enchantés au service de l'Académie.

items.name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
items.note: Chance to drop from Mausoleum Knights wielding it in Liurnia of the Lakes
items.mapNote: Drops from Mausoleum Knights wielding it in Liurnia of the Lakes (chance to drop, not guaranteed)
info: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights.
Pavois en métal décoré d'une éclipse solaire. Porté par les chevaliers sans tête du Mausolée.

items.name: Ice Crest Shield
items.note: On a corpse on a ledge behind the gardens at Caria Manor.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse up on a ledge by a jagged stone pillar. This area is in the gardens, jumping up on the rocks from the Teardrop Scarab nearby.
info: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
Petit bouclier rond en métal. Plus lourd qu'un bouclier en bois, il confère une résistance aux dégâts supérieure.

items.name: Jellyfish Shield
items.note: On a broken wagon next to a corpse surrounded by four Jellyfish, directly north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
items.mapNote: On a dead body surrounded by four Jellyfish directly north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.
info: The head of a spirit jellyfish, commonly found floating above sacred ground throughout the Lands Between, wielded without modification as a shield.
Tête d'une méduse spirituelle, une créature que l'on voit souvent planer au-dessus des lieux saints de l'Entre-terre, employée telle quelle en tant que bouclier.

items.name: Kite Shield
items.note: the Nomadic Merchant in Liurnia of the Lakes for 1000 Runes
info: A standard medium-sized metal shield.
Bouclier en métal classique de taille moyenne.

items.name: Rift Shield
items.note: Purchased from a Nomadic Merchant for 1,800 Runes; Prisoner class starting equipment.
info: Small metal roundshield depicting a sinister rift.
Petit bouclier rond en fer représentant une faille sinistre.

items.name: Spiralhorn Shield
items.note: On a corpse at Uld Palace Ruins in northeast Liurnia, near the Walking Mausoleum from the Ruined Labyrinth grace.
items.mapNote: Found a corpse near Mausoleum Compound. NW of Ruined Labyrinth Site of grace.
info: Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss. Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.
Petit bouclier orné de ramures disposées en forme de tourbillon. Frapper un adversaire avec causera des saignements.

items.name: Carian Knight's Shield
items.note: Looted from Moongrum, the Carian Knight at Raya Lucaria Academy after defeating the enemy.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Moongrum Carian Knight.
info: A teardrop-shaped, medium-sized shield embedded with blue glintstones. Carried by knights who served the Carian royal family.
Bouclier de taille moyenne en forme de larme incrusté de pierres d'éclat bleues, jadis porté par les chevaliers au service de la famille royale de Caria.

items.name: Briar Greatshield
items.note: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar (Bell Bearing Hunter) at The Shaded Castle.
items.mapNote: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle.
info: Greatshield from a foreign land, used by Elemer of the Briar. Attacks with this armament utilize the iron thorns that have been wound around its frame.
Pavois d'une lointaine contrée, brandi par Elemer du Roncier. Les attaques portées avec ce bouclier tirent parti des aiguillons de fer qui l'enserrent.

items.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
items.note: In a chest behind an illusory wall inside Sage's Cave.
items.mapNote: In the Sage's Cave, in a chest behind an illusory wall.
info: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle.
Bouclier en bois de taille moyenne, léger pour sa taille et facile à manier.

items.name: Crossed-Tree Towershield
items.note: The Crossed-Tree Towershield can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant West Altus Plateau, for a total of 3800 Runes.
info: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree.
Pavois en fer assez grand pour se cacher derrière. Frappé d'un vieil emblème d'arbre aux branches entrelacées.

items.name: Distinguished Greatshield
items.note: Purchased from the Hermit Merchant at Hermit Merchant's Shack for 5,500 Runes.
info: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families.
Pavois somptueux porté par les héritiers d'illustres familles.

items.name: Icon Shield
items.note: Inside a crumbling building at Woodfolk Ruins.
items.mapNote: Found inside a crumbling building. Beware of the enemies inside.
info: Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipience of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back fondly on the age of plenty.
Pavois décoré d'une scène divine : la récolte d'une larme bénie de l'Arbre-Monde. Cet objet évoque le souvenir chéri d'une ère d'abondance.

items.name: Perfumer's Shield
items.note: Drops from Perfumer enemies; found at Perfumer's Grotto and the Shaded Castle inner gate.
info: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service.
Bouclier doré employé par les Parfumeurs de Leyndell durant leur service militaire.

items.name: Red Crest Heater Shield
items.note: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace for 2,500 Runes.
info: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
Bouclier en métal de taille moyenne. Plus facile d'utilisation qu'un rempart.

items.name: Scorpion Kite Shield
items.note: Sold by Merchant by Forest-Spanning Great Bridge Site of Grace in Altus Plateau.
info: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability.
Bouclier en métal classique de taille moyenne, réputé pour sa robustesse et sa fiabilité.

items.name: Sun Realm Shield
items.note: Drops from a Sword & Shield Skeleton that crawls out southeast of Hermit Merchant's Shack.
info: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days.
Bouclier honorifique représentant une cité couronnée d'un soleil. Dans un état déplorable.

items.name: Coil Shield
items.note: The Coil Shield is located on a body in Volcano Cave, northeast of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace in Mt.
items.mapNote: Located on a body in Volcano Cave, northeast of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir. You will need to drop down a hole and then double back.
info: Armament designed for gladiatorial combat. Rises above its peers as a particularly showy specimen.
Bouclier conçu pour les combats d'arène, particulièrement ostentatoire comparé à ses homologues.

items.name: Man-Serpent's Shield
items.note: Uncommon drop from shield-wielding Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor; farm near the Guest Hall grace.
info: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir.
Petit bouclier rond cuivré en forme de dôme porté par les reptiliens du Mont Gelmir.

items.name: Smoldering Shield
items.note: On a corpse in the graveyard reached from the Prison Town Church grace at Volcano Manor.
items.mapNote: Found on a corpse on the sitting by some tombstones on the same level as the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.
info: Small shield made upon Mt. Gelmir forged from uncooling lava.
Petit bouclier forgé sur le Mont Gelmir, à partir de lave encore chaude.

items.name: Dragonclaw Shield
items.note: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel fought at Capital Outskirts.
items.mapNote: Greatshield that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel guarding the path into the capital.
info: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree.
Pavois conçu, selon la légende, à partir de la griffe d'un illustre dragon ancien et manié par les grotesques Sentinelles de l'Arbre qui servent l'Arbre-Monde.

items.name: Erdtree Greatshield
items.note: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel Duo guarding the gate at the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo
info: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection.
Pavois pesant en or massif porté par les Sentinelles de l'Arbre, un ordre de chevaliers en armure lourde. Béni par une antique incantation protectrice.

items.name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
items.note: In the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds; behind the chest after Mohg the Omen in the Cathedral of the Forsaken, move the altar to reveal the path.
items.mapNote: Subterranean shunning grounds. Past the Altar you Fight mini boss version of Mohg. After defeating him you can roll/attack the altar behind the chest and it will move down out of the way revealing a path. If you have not defeated Morgott, the Omen King a seal will be blocking further progress. Following this path will lead you to the hardest part which is jumping from coffin to coffin to make your way down to the area. NOTE it is slightly above the bottom floor so do not jump off even if you will survive. If you miss that coffin, you will have to start from the beginning of the coffin descend all over to obtain the shield.
info: A great stone shield with an intricately carved fingerprint design. One of the heaviest of all greatshields. Part of the tomb of an ancient god, the Readerless Fingers relayed their message through these imprints, said to be the very seeds from which frenzy first sprouted.
Grand bouclier de pierre sur lequel ont été gravées des empreintes digitales fort détaillées. L'un des pavois les plus lourds qui soient, il faisait autrefois partie de la tombe d'un dieu ancien.

items.name: Golden Greatshield
items.note: Drops from Leyndell Knights using the shield on their model (bow wielding knights who switch to the shield for close combat will not drop it). Most of which can be found in and around Leyndell, Royal Capital.
info: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell.
Pavois ovale en or massif, porté par les chevaliers protégeant la capitale royale de Leyndell.

items.name: Twinbird Kite Shield
items.note: Dropped by the Deathbird that spawns at night east of the Hermit Merchant's Shack grace in Leyndell.
items.mapNote: Medium Shield dropped by nighttime spawn Deathbird near Leyndell's Hermit Merchant's Shack.
info: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds.
Bouclier aux couleurs vives orné d'un oiseau à deux têtes. Il se raconte que l'oiseau bicéphale serait l'émissaire d'une Divinité extérieure et aurait donné naissance aux rapaces funestes.

items.name: Banished Knight's Shield
items.note: Drops from Banished Knights; can be farmed from one near the Cathedral of Dragon Communion Site of Grace.
info: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.
Bouclier en métal allongé de taille moyenne. Remis aux chevaliers contraints de quitter leur foyer pour des raisons obscures, peut-être en guise de blâme ou simplement par la force des choses.

items.name: Pillory Shield
items.note: Inside Gaol Cave (northeast of Fort Gael); requires 2 Stonesword Keys to access.
items.mapNote: Found inside Gaol Cave.
info: Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such.
Pilori servant à châtier les plus vils scélérats, employé en guise de bouclier. Bien qu'il soit fait de bois robuste, il demeure un outil improvisé et ses performances s'en ressentent.

items.name: Redmane Greatshield
items.note: Dropped by Redmane Knights in Caelid. Can drop from the horseback Redmane Knight found northwest of the Impassable Greatbridge Site of Grace.
info: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.
Pavois en forme de croc, frappé de l'emblème du Lion rouge. Porté par les chevaliers du Lion rouge qui guerroyèrent aux côtés de Radahn.

items.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
items.note: On a dead body under a Golem, west of the Deep Siofra Well.
items.mapNote: On dead body under a Golem, west of Deep Siofra Well, Caelid
info: A large wooden shield covered with spikes. Though relatively light, it lacks in damage negation.
Grand bouclier en bois hérissé de pics. Plutôt léger, sa résistance aux dégâts laisse à désirer.

items.name: Visage Shield
items.note: In a chest in an underground area east of Caelem Ruins, after the Mad Pumpkin Head duo.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest in a small room behind the Mad Pumpkin Head duo bosses. Accessible after defeating them.
info: Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mouth.
Bouclier complexe en bronze représentant le visage d'un Géant de feu. Plusieurs langues surgissent de sa bouche béante.

items.name: One-Eyed Shield
items.note: Dropped by mini-boss NPC Chief Guardian Arghanthy inside Guardians' Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants.
items.mapNote: Dropped by mini-boss NPC Chief Guardian Arghanthy inside Guardian's Garrison.
info: Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth.
Bouclier complexe en pierre blanche représentant un dieu cyclope difforme. Le canon d'une arme à feu dépasse de sa bouche béante.

items.name: Silver Mirrorshield
items.note: Inside the Apostate Derelict (destroyed church) in the northern area of Consecrated Snowfield.
items.mapNote: Shield found in the Apostate Derelict church.
info: Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
Bouclier en argent resplendissant paré d'ambre porté par Loretta, chevaleresse de l'Arbre-Sacré.

items.name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
items.note: Alternatively, from the Haligtree Roots Site of Grace, turn around and go up the elevator. Once you reach the top, run straight until you're outside the Church.
info: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.
Pavois en métal orné d'une image de l'Arbre-Sacré en or pur. Porté par les chevaliers qui ont juré allégeance à l'Arbre-Sacré de Miquella.

items.name: Beastman's Jar-Shield
items.note: Drops from an Azula Beastman in the room near the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Found in the room next to the site of the grace.
info: Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it.
Bouclier réalisé à partir d'un grand fragment de jarre, porté par les hommes-bêtes de Farum Azula. Le manier demande un certain tour de main.

items.name: Dragon Towershield
items.note: In a chest guarded by a Banished Knight, reached by dropping down from the Dragon Temple Rooftop Site of Grace.
items.mapNote: Found in a chest in the terrace section of a building far to the bottom of the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. This building can be reached by dropping down a series of cliffs east of the plaza until you see the archway leading into the building. Follow the linear path from here to a lower balcony with a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the terrace and look to the east to find the chest by the railings.
info: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability.
Égide arborant une gravure de dragon, symbole de protection. Ce pavois particulièrement lourd assure une garde exceptionnelle.

items.name: Ant's Skull Plate
items.note: In a chest in Nokstella, Eternal City; head west from the Eternal City grace, up the stairs, into the room with a Nox Swordstress.
info: Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repelling enemy attacks.
Énorme tête d'une des fourmis géantes vivant sur les berges des deux rivières souterraines, employée telle quelle en tant que bouclier. Repousse avec brio les attaques ennemies.

items.name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
items.note: Drops from Fallen Hawks Soldiers found just outside the Nokron, Eternal City grace.
info: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest.
Pavois en fer assez grand pour se cacher derrière. Frappé d'un emblème de faucon inversé.

items.name: Crucible Hornshield
items.note: Guaranteed drop from the Crucible Knight patrolling the bridges in the Siofra Aqueduct.
info: Greatshield of red-tinged gold carried by Crucible Knights. Features a great horn.
Pavois en or carmin porté par les chevaliers du Creuset. Doté d'une corne massive.

items.name: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
items.note: On a body southeast of the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace, up a hill near the stairs to Hallowhorn Grounds.
info: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
Bouclier en métal de taille moyenne. Plus facile d'utilisation qu'un rempart.

items.name: Carian Thrusting Shield
items.note: ng location: Shadow Keep: From the "Storehouse, Back Section" site of grace, go west and you will reach a room where you find a Fire Knight and a few other enemies
info: Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously.
Bouclier d'estoc en argent serti de pierres d'éclat. Permet à son porteur d'attaquer et de garder simultanément.

items.name: Dueling Shield
items.note: In Shadow Keep; from the Storehouse First Floor grace, go north around the specimen pillar to the stairs.
info: A thrusting shield of golden ornamentation which enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously.
Bouclier d'estoc permettant d'attaquer et de garder simultanément.

items.name: Golden Lion Shield
items.note: Given by Redmane Freyja after handing over the Letter for Freyja received from Sir Ansbach.
info: Shield made to resemble a fierce golden lion with a luxuriant mane.
Bouclier représentant un féroce lion doré à la crinière touffue.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Shield
items.note: Has a 2.00% chance to be dropped by Messmer Soldiers, from shield-wielding Messmer Soldiers. Found in camps across Gravesite Plain and Scadu Altus, and inside Castle Ensis and Shadow Keep.
info: Worn roundshield carried by soldiers loyal to Messmer, the Impaler.
Bouclier rond usé porté par les soldats fidèles à Messmer l'Empaleur.

items.name: Black Steel Greatshield
items.note: Dropped by Black Knight Garrew at Fog Rift Fort (near Castle Ensis).
info: Weighty shields carried by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Made of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.
Pesant bouclier porté par les chevaliers noirs, au service de Messmer l'Empaleur, forgé en acier noir et paré d'ornements dorés.

items.name: Serpent Crest Shield
items.note: Reward for solving the Incursion Painting; the ghost appears west of the Greatbridge North grace near the dragon lake.
info: A finely-made "redshield" featuring an engraving of a winged serpent. Excels at guarding against fire.
Somptueux bouclier rouge décoré d'une gravure de serpent ailé. Protège merveilleusement bien du feu.

items.name: Wolf Crest Shield
items.note: In a chest in a storeroom at Castle Ensis, reached through a gap in the northwest corner of Moonrithyll's courtyard.
info: A finely-made "blueshield" featuring an engraving of a wolf under the moon. Excels at fending off sorceries.
Somptueux bouclier bleu décoré d'une gravure de loup sous la lune. Dévie les sorcelleries avec brio.

items.name: Shield of Night
items.note: On a ledge behind a corpse atop a table in Bonny Gaol; reach the top level via the jar lift near the bridge.
info: A shield awarded to Swordhands of Night, cast in a bottomless black from which no light can escape.
Bouclier décerné aux épéistes nocturnes, d'un noir si profond qu'il ne renvoie aucune lumière.

items.name: Smithscript Shield
items.note: At Taylew's Ruined Forge; defeat the Golem Smiths and reach the upper platform at the end of the hallway.
info: Roundshield engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.
Bouclier rond porteur d'une inscription forgegraphe. Cette arme de jet est l'œuvre d'un artisan de talent.

items.name: Verdigris Greatshield
items.note: Dropped by NPC Moore when defeated; he invades near the Church of the Crusade / after the Forager Brood Pest.
info: Greatshield made of the unusual metal known as verdigris.
Pavois conçu en un métal rare nommé vert-de-gris.

items.name: Crimson Tear Scarab
items.mapNote: Can be found after jumping off the balcony and making it to the building with the broken window/ half the floor missing, the item is to their left (hop the railing) and a silver scarab to their right (can be killed from the mini bridge).
items.note: On a rocky ledge at Volcano Manor , Altus Plateau . To reach the Crimson Tear Scarab, start from the Temple of Eiglay site of grace. Route A: If you have activated the wooden elevator in the tower to the north, ride it to the top. After the elevator reaches the top, exit the room via the doorway to the northeast. Look over the railing to the south; there is a ledge below with a corpse. Route B: Take the stone lift south of the Temple of Eiglay grace. Walk out to the balcony, and jump down to a rocky ledge to the east. Follow the path past Burning Slugs up to the top. Head northwest to the nearest tower, where an Abductor Virgin appears. Jump into the open window of the tower. Exit the room through a door to the right. Right before the Man-Serpent wielding a burning sword, look over the railing to the south to see a ledge with a corpse. The Crimson Tear Scarab can be looted from that corpse.
